programme.title: 主日讲坛-中国基督教播道会同福堂
programme.desc: 中国基督教播道会同福堂 讲题:职场上的好撒马利亚人 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪.透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意.

programme.title: 专题讲座:张路加牧师宣教培灵系列
programme.desc: 华人福音工作是现今最大的禾场,我们需要怎样的装备,将福音的种子带到华人当中?就让拥有丰富牧会经验的张路加牧师,教大家好好装备,在福音的道路上奔跑吧.

programme.title: 喜乐婆婆会客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子乔妈,人称「喜乐婆婆」,一生经历操练出一套喜乐心得,她更请来一众嘉宾好友,分享人生中大小风浪,靠著的是同出一辙的喜乐秘诀,在节目中娓娓道出那份属天的快乐.

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 铁证待判
programme.desc: 地球深度行4之铁证待判继续以游历的方式,走进荷兰,土耳其,约旦,敍利亚,涉及接近50个地点,超过30个已经发生嘅神迹预言,传奇故事,以考古和实证,重新解构连科学都不能解释的千古谜团. 历年来有无数的考古学家和世界知名的纪录片频道,为了解开上帝藉著摩西施行神迹分割红海这个历史迷团,他们都不惜花上大..

programme.title: 天下华人唱出好诗歌大赛大赛
programme.desc: 由影音使团,香港福音盛会,华福会香港区委会,以勒基金主办,创世电视首届「天下华人唱出好诗歌」大赛,冠军即将诞生.世上最美的声音,是生命重生的声音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影.500位参加者,一年训练,成长,比并,同行,要成为祝福城市的好声音.

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时,碰壁有时,迷失有时,觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角. 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死,迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地..

programme.title: 如果还有明天2 艺人﹐警察﹐过来人
programme.desc: 在社会上有三类人,他们的故事往往起伏跌宕,引人注目. 艺人─身处五光十色的娱乐圈,昨日一炮而红,今天却随时一沉百踩,明天,是黯淡无光抑或光辉璀璨? 员警─冲锋陷阵,与死亡正面交锋的职业,在捍卫他人生命和财产,让市民有美好明天时,自己的明天又能否好好捍卫? 过来人─昔日在黑道中打混,见尽各种腥风血雨的..

programme.title: 福气教会讲道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康强盛的教会? 改变社区可以转化城市? 作为基督徒,我们又如何尽忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一个「幸福小组」,让教会续步履行三个使命!由台湾高雄福气教会牧者主讲,从圣经的话语开始,一起来学习「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 刘三论今-家和万事兴系列

programme.title: 迈阿密风云

programme.title: 方世玉续集

programme.title: 战舰世纪

programme.title: 未来总动员

programme.desc: 一名南非金矿工头在不知情的情况下,遭一群无良金融家操纵,他们企图淹没矿坑,以推高全球金价。

programme.title: 魔鬼命令
programme.desc: 两名在越战中阵亡的士兵多年后被改造成半人半机的超级战士。然而,当记忆逐渐苏醒,他们挣脱束缚,在昔日战友之间展开了一场残酷的对决。

programme.title: 夺宝大战: 重返水晶骷髅王国
programme.desc: 冒险家弗林.卡森收到一幅指向所罗门王矿脉的神秘地图。当地图被盗后,弗林踏上旅程寻回地图及《所罗门之钥》,一旦缺少这本书,地图也将变得毫无用处。

programme.title: 玩命关头: 特别行动
programme.desc: 在这部火爆的《玩命关头》外传中,霍布斯与萧联手对抗拥有致命生化武器的超级反派!动作场面震撼升级,巨石强森、杰森·史塔森、伊卓瑞斯·艾尔巴领衔主演,火力全开,不容错过!

programme.title: 美国杀人魔
programme.desc: 派屈克・贝特曼是一名在华尔街、于父亲公司任职的年轻人,却毫无理由地杀人。随著日子一天天过去,他对世界的仇恨愈发强烈。这部极度黑暗的黑色喜剧改编自布雷特・伊斯顿・艾利斯的同名小说。

programme.title: 模范家庭 #3
programme.desc: 一个单亲妈妈郁香和她的女儿童童搬进了一个住宅区展开新生活。区内住著一个个看似幸福美满的家庭,背后却藏著许多不为人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭开. . .

programme.title: 7ujuh (aka 7Seven: A Vengeful Suri)
programme.desc: 7个朋友踏上旅程,前往村长和女儿Suri经营的偏远平房。他们举行派对,并请求Suri担任侍应。随著派对逐渐失控,Suri不幸遭强暴。在自杀前,她对这7个人施下咒怨,使他们受到恶梦的缠扰。随著这7人一个..

programme.title: 青木劫
programme.desc: 民国初年,富甲一方的康氏惨遭灭门,唯一的目击证人—家中的幼女—在亲眼目睹全家被杀后离奇失踪。几十年间,位于青木巷的废弃康宅充斥著灵异惊悚的气氛。随著真相逐渐揭露,这个恐怖的疑团交织著复仇与死亡的动机。

programme.title: Room For Rent
programme.desc: 寂寞的寡妇Joyce疯狂迷恋年轻的新租客。渴望得到爱情的她,为追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障碍,甚至要杀人灭口也在所不计!因而展开了一个令人毛骨悚然的迷恋故事 …

programme.title: 凌晨三点钟 - 营地
programme.desc: 一群漠视劝诫的年青人贸然闯进诡异森林露营作乐,入夜之后,他们内心的邪念驱使他们落入性与爱的关系陷阱,引来了森林里一连串的灵异事件。黎明将至,他们当中有谁能逃生?

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: 玛莉因丈夫工作上的调迁,搬回位于郊区的家乡。当玛莉在新房子等候丈夫的时候,一个冰淇淋车杀手已把她视为下一个要杀掉的目标人物。此刻,玛莉发觉家乡已不如昔日般平静安宁…

programme.title: 替身纸人
programme.desc: 警方在调查一宗团伙杀人案时,突然又发生了离奇的纸人杀人事件,嫌疑人一个接一个的被杀。随著不断挖出的线索,警方最终发现这背后隐藏著横跨两代人的秘密与悲剧。

programme.title: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)

programme.desc: 当年轻母亲为女儿莫名失踪而苦恼时,一连串怪异的事件接踵而至。这都可能与二十年前的意外亡魂为复仇归来有关…

programme.title: Chop Chop

programme.title: 开棺
programme.desc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盗墓团伙重现江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盗墓贼在开棺时遇惊魂邪煞,逃离后又接连惨死家中。最终古墓尸毒和针孔成为留给员警沈春合仅有的线索,看似普通的盗墓案,瞬间扑朔迷离疑点重重。

programme.title: 冥婚
programme.desc: 摄影师陈志成长年被一名「红衣女子」纠缠,导致多位亲人惨死;甚至连自己心仪的女孩思桐亦难逃恶运。志成欲寻找思桐惨死的真相,却揭发关于一场「冥婚」的秘密...

programme.title: Isolation (2015)
programme.desc: 根据真实故事改编。克顿为挽救濒临破碎的婚姻,带著妻子到巴哈马群岛度假,却不幸遇上现代海盗的追杀。夫妇二人除了彼此之外,没有人可以信任,被迫同心合力为生存而战。

programme.title: 纸人回魂
programme.desc: 一位记者调查二十年前纸人回魂案时,听到三个关于恐怖纸人的故事。故事起源于乔府大小姐乔媛媛枉死后,管家请纸扎匠为小姐做了纸人陪葬。纸人被点眼睛后,大小姐得以借纸人回魂复仇,更接二连三引发连串与纸人有关的..

programme.desc: 一名年轻男子被困在一座废弃的房子里,拼命要寻找自己被困的线索。原来真相隐藏在连串被疯传的影片内,而这些影像亦逐渐影响了他的思想…

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
programme.desc: 孤儿Azlinda从小就受到鬼魂的困扰,相信这些折磨与父母的暗黑历史密切相关。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz携手合作,希望结束她的痛苦,但却被一个邪恶的恶魔阻挠。Azlinda能否成功斩断..

programme.title: 模范家庭 #2
programme.desc: 一个单亲妈妈郁香和她的女儿童童搬进了一个住宅区展开新生活。区内住著一个个看似幸福美满的家庭,背后却藏著许多不为人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭开. . .

programme.title: 荒岛尸变
programme.desc: 一向酷爱钻研丧尸的Jeff,为追求刺激与朋友们勇闯一个荒废多年的神秘小岛。初时众人以为是个普通探险之旅,但冒险之旅却顿变为惊栗的旅程。直到他们被困荒岛,遇到丧尸的袭击,毫无还击之力之余,面对死亡的边缘..

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: 当年轻的Evie在海滩上发现一条受诅咒的项链时,她并未察觉其中隐藏的邪恶力量。随著项链的暗黑力量逐渐侵蚀她的意志,她无意中唤醒了恐怖的水魔,而这个水魔将威胁到她和她所爱之人的性命。

programme.title: 一步一脚印 发现新台湾
一步一脚印 发现新台湾(重)
万凰之王#1[粤]
programme.desc: 慎贵妃佟佳沅宛被册封皇后在即，众妃嫔特意前来到贺，芸妃批评穆王福晋钮祜禄伊兰只送上兰花作贺礼，沅宛解释该盆兰花被喻为兰花之后。自小照顾伊兰的崔嬷嬷认为皇后之位应该属于伊兰，但伊兰只希望早日与穆亲王绵怡重逢。放天灯大会上，太后大赞诰命夫人倩柔将女儿沅宛培育得大方得体。仪式突然出意外，道光皇帝第一时间冲上前保护伊兰，令沅宛生妒意。钦天监官员表示落雹乃不祥之兆，建议下旨活葬伊兰，道光拒绝。另边厢，太后则对殉葬一事大表支持。道光与沅宛举行大婚仪式之时，伊兰则被送往皇陵接受殉葬……

programme.title: 扑水冤家#13[粤]
programme.desc: 善美变得疯疯癫癫，向少芬要求金钱支援，少芬教她拖欠租金，便打发她离去。浩仁约会慧晴，慧晴将自制的石头公仔送给浩仁，浩仁大悦。文昌知Kevin玩弄Angel感情，挥拳打他，闹上警署。志祥被小玲拒爱后变得自暴自弃，小玲鼓励他振作。善美的包租婆派人搬走善美的电视机作为偿还欠租，善美故意弄花电视机，阻止他们搬走。浩琛驾替更的士，被人打劫后又遭抄牌，苦不堪言，回家后善美更跟他斗嘴，善美一时冲动提出各行各路，浩琛气愤离家出走，小玲见他在街上露宿，遂收留他回家暂住。

programme.title: 扑水冤家#14[粤]
programme.desc: 吴娇答应负责浩琛的起居饮食，浩琛内心感激。君祖帮善美交租及加薪给她，喜朗及喜宁知道后不悦，转告浩琛。浩琛约善美见面，要求她辞职，善美断然拒绝，浩琛将行动升级执拾行李搬走，逼美尽快表态。志祥单人匹马往找黑社会大佬追数，被打至重伤，志祥见小玲关心自己感后大悦。小玲讹称浩琛是其男友，要志祥知难而退。喜朗搬进与浩琛同住，欲与喜宁里应外合令君祖离开善美。杨小莉胁持富豪曾展鹏，要求取回儿子的抚养权，最后小莉束手就擒，此事经广泛报道，文昌不收分毫主动保释小莉，更义务帮她打官司。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-东方之珠#10[粤]
programme.desc: 吉教兰唱俄文歌，以隐瞒口齿不清的实态。燕因丰盛名，不少学生慕名而至而感大乐；继威后，康受教授之托，接手充当丽的导师。歌唱比赛最后一天，在大等人的安排下，成功令燕收兰为徒，但燕终发现被设局，用尽方法折磨兰，但兰竟不知去向，原来她因行善背著不适的婆婆到医院；而为改善缺憾，兰努力苦练可惜效果不彰，于是更改用玻璃珠来练习。娇力劝兰放弃，但经威推波助澜，反让以能与丰同台演出为目标，更加倍努力，然而及后因意外弄跌满盘玻璃珠，险让燕滑倒地上，而兰竟舍身救师父而受伤。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-东方之珠#11[粤]
programme.desc: 兰舍身救燕令自己满嘴碎玻璃珠受伤送院。另一方面，娇突然造访凤家，幸得丽帮忙令康偷偷练习之事才得免曝光。康得知此事后，礼尚往来主动教丽弹结他。兰出院得燕正式收为入室弟子。另一边厢，丰及威兄弟与华探长太太洪杏娟结识，她更成为丰的忠实歌迷。丰因开罪升与唱片公司老板，灌录首张个人大碟一事险告吹，威将此事透露予华探长太太，望借助其影响力度过难关。吉因怕兰出洋相，特安排燕和丰摆和头酒欲私下取消赌约，燕却偶然听到威出言不逊，主动在台上介绍兰为入室弟子「薰兰」，令以为取消赌约的丰错愕不已。

programme.title: 毕打自己人#25[粤]
programme.desc: 器未能赶及返港出席会议，遂派继女儿王丽薇出席。薇在会上针对赏，仁认定薇怕赏瓜分器的家财。坚得知薇欲对付自己，随即致电龙师傅求助；原来薇也是龙的客人，薇更要求坚陷害赏作弥补。会计部万人迷猛男Herman在《潮》出现，更主动与赏打招呼，赏被Herman分散注意力签下文件；例会上Herman把一文件交予赏，赏发现，一份不法交易的文件有自己签名，幸仁突然扮羊痫症发作解围。原来仁收到一个短讯，指有办法证明赏是无辜。仁发现真正贪污者是宋理忠，查出该装有证据的电脑是属于Herman……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#26[粤]
programme.desc: 赏与器发现汝大申请当《潮》摄影师后不禁大惊；两人为阻止大加入，竟托不知情的珊任面试官；想不到珊对大极满意，要求大翌日上班。一星期后，器与赏返港，两人深信执著的大已被编采部的同事淘汰。但却发现他与众人关系良好得令赏难以置信。赏鼓起勇气向大提出要亲身考验他才算通过试用期，遂连同仁把大带往访问刚出狱的黑社会人物飞龙，大不消一会已完成采访，却发现素岳等负责排版的同事早已离去。翌日，器看到最新出版的《潮》满意至极，当知道一切全是大的功劳，器顿感迷惘……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#27[粤]
programme.desc: 军等人得知大的真正身分后议论纷纷，深怕大是器派来的奸细；众人商讨对大的称呼，最后决定跟随赏的决定。然而赏与仁亦为对大的称呼而烦恼，因赏从大学开始已尊称大为「师兄」，即使婚后亦如是。此时大出现，儿礼貌地称大为「大哥」，为众人解决了难题。大著钓具到海旁，忆起十多年前器曾希望他当说客说服薇改姓闫，但薇竟以喜欢「闫王联婚」的理由拒绝大，结果大离家出走。如今大则认为薇另有目的，才匆匆返港求证。赏等人到器家出席晚宴，器突感胸口不适，众人以为器心脏病发，器借机提出多个条件要求大答应……

programme.title: 万凰之王#2[粤]
programme.desc: 道光得悉伊兰将要殉葬，竟不顾一切赶赴皇陵相救。太后心腹卫公公阻止道光救人，道光下令斩首，幸得太后救回。瑞亲王绵忻远征归来，并带同绵怡的骨灰。道光表示绵怡曾于梦中交托代为照顾伊兰，遂纳伊兰为全妃。沅宛对封后大典被中断而耿耿于怀，得悉伊兰被册封为妃更为激动。沅宛为严防伊兰地位超越自己，安插心腹宫女彩蓝到伊兰身边。伊兰得悉太后久咳未愈，悉心炮制花茶让她开声，谁知反令太后的病情加剧。瑞亲王对沅宛于深夜来到穆亲王祭室感到奇怪，原来沅宛质疑祭室内的并非穆亲王骨灰。

programme.title: 扑水冤家#15[粤]
programme.desc: 文昌拉小玲去学校见小莉的儿子曾立新，竟发现他出外写生后不知所终，文昌最后在小莉家找回他，发现两母子的感情非常要好。君祖拖欠两个月租金，众同事以为公司快将倒闭，善美即替君祖说好话。浩琛成功考取保安业牌照，被编到君祖公司所在的大厦当保安员。常满上君祖的公司找晦气，并将君祖给大客的合约撕毁，君祖一怒下推开常满，浩琛以为君祖对常满不敬，出手打君祖，浩琛即时被解雇。小莉上诉抚养权的个案开审，展鹏聘请资深大律师Nelson对战，文昌将Nelson对小莉患病及经济问题的理据逐一驳回。

programme.title: 扑水冤家#16[粤]
programme.desc: 文昌相约小玲吃饭庆祝打赢小莉的官司，小玲却认为文昌应与Angel庆祝而不是自己，文昌忙向小玲解释与Angel的关系。小玲发现Nelson与文昌的合照，始知二人是父子关系，但因价值观不同变成陌路人。浩琛在常满相劝下再平心静气跟善美倾谈，但最终却不欢而散。善美跟君祖到台湾公干，托少芬照顾喜宁，少芬只顾打麻将，浩琛马上到少芬家接走喜宁。浩仁约慧晴到郊外烧烤，慧晴反约世良一同前往，世良不改作风带众人往酒店烧烤，累浩仁大失预算。善美回港得知喜宁被浩琛接走，气冲冲往吴娇家接回喜宁。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-东方之珠#12[粤]
programme.desc: 因祸得福，反而消除了口齿不清的兰成功入围，而赛后丰为免尴尬特意从后门离开，却被燕带同大批记者包围。在华探长夫人娟的帮忙下，丰的唱片问题得以解决，丰为报答娟而陪同一起选购眼镜。因兰台风强差人意，燕等改变策略，要她改唱慢歌。兰与丰在游乐场游玩排解心中闷气，但却撞见燕，令赌约再升级；兰进退两难，最后决定以病避战。吉促丰处理二人的感情问题，丰遂约兰表明心迹。康教授常美丽结他时，邀到参赛现场打气，但丽怕人多而未有答应。兰失踪，丰得知后宁愿取消与唱片公司老板开会，与燕等找寻玉兰踪影。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-东方之珠#13[粤]
programme.desc: 兰独自回到围村，燕找到兰但说服失败。康参加比赛之事终被发现，娇不肯妥协，更剪断结他弦线，康愤而出走。丽到场为康打气却未能如愿，凤告知真相，反激起丽对母亲的不满。而同一时间燕准备向大会解释退出，不料兰竟到场参赛，以悲伤情歌感动各人，赢得掌声雷动，及后更未等结果宣布就欲离去，不料竟由另一表现平平的参赛者夺得大奖。丰质疑赛果往找升，意外得知得奖者马伟明竟是申老板私生子。及后意外为吉得知，促丰向记者交待事情真相，丰因此开罪申老板，唱片被取消发行送到堆填区压碎，不料威竟因此迁怒于丰。

programme.title: 毕打自己人#28[粤]
programme.desc: 因大的身分，在集团中享尽特权，令众人不满；此时坚把编采部的粮单派予众人，却未见大的粮单，赏直言大乃直属金波集团而非编采部，众人对于未能声讨大感不忿。大发现原来无法出示员工证者须以二百元行政费用补领，并要直属上司亲自接回办公室。大特意说遗失员工证但拒绝补领，器感丢脸仍为他付行政费。军等人指大连续数天遗失员工证的行为非常无聊，决定利用舆论压力阻止他。大故技重施，器终于忍不住怒骂大，反被大质问至哑口无言。器勒令取消规定，并答应把扣起的行政费全数退还……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#29[粤]
programme.desc: 器希望大能够列席部门例会，遂安排秘书June把议程交予大，但大却随手把议程撕毁。会议上，薇犹如洞悉一切，对会上提出的问题均提出解决方案，器大为满意。薇成功是因June预先把每个部门的资料交予薇。当薇得知坚是两朝元老便欲拉拢她。坚接到高级秘书美玲的邀请出席行政秘书的会议，会议上June向坚套取薇欲知道的资料，令坚感到压力。玲更通知坚，其好友琴将会因「莫须有」而收到警告信，提醒坚不应连累朋友。坚使计令众人目睹她们反目成仇。薇见状故意卖人情给坚，要June把警告信先行搁置……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#30[粤]
programme.desc: 赏不经意与见珊与Ally，赏更听到珊称Ally为「阿女」；因赏听到Ally是生于1979年、令她怀疑Ally是其同父异母的亲妹。赏购买一件万元长褛予德，德穿上西装与长褛后一脸欢喜，尤其对西装上的袋巾最为满意，扬言终于感到「父女情深」。原来袋巾是Ally相赠的，赏不禁深信骨肉相连的道理，德不以为然附和她，赏才把事情娓娓道来，吓得德匆匆离去。珊气急败坏地闯进会议，凝重地命令众人离去后指责赏。原来赏不慎把名片留在服装店，珊担心Ally当上封面故事，只好妥协把前夫的家事如实相告……

programme.title: 万凰之王#2[粤]
programme.desc: 道光得悉伊兰将要殉葬，竟不顾一切赶赴皇陵相救。太后心腹卫公公阻止道光救人，道光下令斩首，幸得太后救回。瑞亲王绵忻远征归来，并带同绵怡的骨灰。道光表示绵怡曾于梦中交托代为照顾伊兰，遂纳伊兰为全妃。沅宛对封后大典被中断而耿耿于怀，得悉伊兰被册封为妃更为激动。沅宛为严防伊兰地位超越自己，安插心腹宫女彩蓝到伊兰身边。伊兰得悉太后久咳未愈，悉心炮制花茶让她开声，谁知反令太后的病情加剧。瑞亲王对沅宛于深夜来到穆亲王祭室感到奇怪，原来沅宛质疑祭室内的并非穆亲王骨灰。

programme.title: 扑水冤家#15[粤]
programme.desc: 文昌拉小玲去学校见小莉的儿子曾立新，竟发现他出外写生后不知所终，文昌最后在小莉家找回他，发现两母子的感情非常要好。君祖拖欠两个月租金，众同事以为公司快将倒闭，善美即替君祖说好话。浩琛成功考取保安业牌照，被编到君祖公司所在的大厦当保安员。常满上君祖的公司找晦气，并将君祖给大客的合约撕毁，君祖一怒下推开常满，浩琛以为君祖对常满不敬，出手打君祖，浩琛即时被解雇。小莉上诉抚养权的个案开审，展鹏聘请资深大律师Nelson对战，文昌将Nelson对小莉患病及经济问题的理据逐一驳回。

programme.title: 扑水冤家#16[粤]
programme.desc: 文昌相约小玲吃饭庆祝打赢小莉的官司，小玲却认为文昌应与Angel庆祝而不是自己，文昌忙向小玲解释与Angel的关系。小玲发现Nelson与文昌的合照，始知二人是父子关系，但因价值观不同变成陌路人。浩琛在常满相劝下再平心静气跟善美倾谈，但最终却不欢而散。善美跟君祖到台湾公干，托少芬照顾喜宁，少芬只顾打麻将，浩琛马上到少芬家接走喜宁。浩仁约慧晴到郊外烧烤，慧晴反约世良一同前往，世良不改作风带众人往酒店烧烤，累浩仁大失预算。善美回港得知喜宁被浩琛接走，气冲冲往吴娇家接回喜宁。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-东方之珠#12[粤]
programme.desc: 因祸得福，反而消除了口齿不清的兰成功入围，而赛后丰为免尴尬特意从后门离开，却被燕带同大批记者包围。在华探长夫人娟的帮忙下，丰的唱片问题得以解决，丰为报答娟而陪同一起选购眼镜。因兰台风强差人意，燕等改变策略，要她改唱慢歌。兰与丰在游乐场游玩排解心中闷气，但却撞见燕，令赌约再升级；兰进退两难，最后决定以病避战。吉促丰处理二人的感情问题，丰遂约兰表明心迹。康教授常美丽结他时，邀到参赛现场打气，但丽怕人多而未有答应。兰失踪，丰得知后宁愿取消与唱片公司老板开会，与燕等找寻玉兰踪影。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-东方之珠#13[粤]
programme.desc: 兰独自回到围村，燕找到兰但说服失败。康参加比赛之事终被发现，娇不肯妥协，更剪断结他弦线，康愤而出走。丽到场为康打气却未能如愿，凤告知真相，反激起丽对母亲的不满。而同一时间燕准备向大会解释退出，不料兰竟到场参赛，以悲伤情歌感动各人，赢得掌声雷动，及后更未等结果宣布就欲离去，不料竟由另一表现平平的参赛者夺得大奖。丰质疑赛果往找升，意外得知得奖者马伟明竟是申老板私生子。及后意外为吉得知，促丰向记者交待事情真相，丰因此开罪申老板，唱片被取消发行送到堆填区压碎，不料威竟因此迁怒于丰。

programme.title: 毕打自己人#28[粤]
programme.desc: 因大的身分，在集团中享尽特权，令众人不满；此时坚把编采部的粮单派予众人，却未见大的粮单，赏直言大乃直属金波集团而非编采部，众人对于未能声讨大感不忿。大发现原来无法出示员工证者须以二百元行政费用补领，并要直属上司亲自接回办公室。大特意说遗失员工证但拒绝补领，器感丢脸仍为他付行政费。军等人指大连续数天遗失员工证的行为非常无聊，决定利用舆论压力阻止他。大故技重施，器终于忍不住怒骂大，反被大质问至哑口无言。器勒令取消规定，并答应把扣起的行政费全数退还……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#29[粤]
programme.desc: 器希望大能够列席部门例会，遂安排秘书June把议程交予大，但大却随手把议程撕毁。会议上，薇犹如洞悉一切，对会上提出的问题均提出解决方案，器大为满意。薇成功是因June预先把每个部门的资料交予薇。当薇得知坚是两朝元老便欲拉拢她。坚接到高级秘书美玲的邀请出席行政秘书的会议，会议上June向坚套取薇欲知道的资料，令坚感到压力。玲更通知坚，其好友琴将会因「莫须有」而收到警告信，提醒坚不应连累朋友。坚使计令众人目睹她们反目成仇。薇见状故意卖人情给坚，要June把警告信先行搁置……

programme.desc: 兰独自回到围村，燕找到兰但说服失败。康参加比赛之事终被发现，娇不肯妥协，更剪断结他弦线，康愤而出走。丽到场为康打气却未能如愿，凤告知真相，反激起丽对母亲的不满。而同一时间燕准备向大会解释退出，不料兰竟到场参赛，以悲伤情歌感动各人，赢得掌声雷动，及后更未等结果宣布就欲离去，不料竟由另一表现平平的参赛者夺得大奖。丰质疑赛果往找升，意外得知得奖者马伟明竟是申老板私生子。及后意外为吉得知，促丰向记者交待事情真相，丰因此开罪申老板，唱片被取消发行送到堆填区压碎，不料威竟因此迁怒于丰。

programme.title: 毕打自己人#28[粤]
programme.desc: 因大的身分，在集团中享尽特权，令众人不满；此时坚把编采部的粮单派予众人，却未见大的粮单，赏直言大乃直属金波集团而非编采部，众人对于未能声讨大感不忿。大发现原来无法出示员工证者须以二百元行政费用补领，并要直属上司亲自接回办公室。大特意说遗失员工证但拒绝补领，器感丢脸仍为他付行政费。军等人指大连续数天遗失员工证的行为非常无聊，决定利用舆论压力阻止他。大故技重施，器终于忍不住怒骂大，反被大质问至哑口无言。器勒令取消规定，并答应把扣起的行政费全数退还……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#29[粤]
programme.desc: 器希望大能够列席部门例会，遂安排秘书June把议程交予大，但大却随手把议程撕毁。会议上，薇犹如洞悉一切，对会上提出的问题均提出解决方案，器大为满意。薇成功是因June预先把每个部门的资料交予薇。当薇得知坚是两朝元老便欲拉拢她。坚接到高级秘书美玲的邀请出席行政秘书的会议，会议上June向坚套取薇欲知道的资料，令坚感到压力。玲更通知坚，其好友琴将会因「莫须有」而收到警告信，提醒坚不应连累朋友。坚使计令众人目睹她们反目成仇。薇见状故意卖人情给坚，要June把警告信先行搁置……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#30[粤]
programme.desc: 赏不经意与见珊与Ally，赏更听到珊称Ally为「阿女」；因赏听到Ally是生于1979年、令她怀疑Ally是其同父异母的亲妹。赏购买一件万元长褛予德，德穿上西装与长褛后一脸欢喜，尤其对西装上的袋巾最为满意，扬言终于感到「父女情深」。原来袋巾是Ally相赠的，赏不禁深信骨肉相连的道理，德不以为然附和她，赏才把事情娓娓道来，吓得德匆匆离去。珊气急败坏地闯进会议，凝重地命令众人离去后指责赏。原来赏不慎把名片留在服装店，珊担心Ally当上封面故事，只好妥协把前夫的家事如实相告……

programme.title: 万凰之王#3[粤]
programme.desc: 沅宛不满瑞亲王撮合道光与伊兰，出言指责，瑞亲王反唇相讥。沅宛欲将道光为保伊兰一命而说谎之事禀报太后，遭母亲倩柔阻止，提醒她先在后宫站稳阵脚。沅宛欲借太后最重视的品茗大会，向后宫众人施下马威。道光知伊兰独爱种花，打算向她请教栽花之道，伊兰以种花作比喻，希望道光知难而退。伊兰为证实宫女彩荞无辜，间接揭发芸妃私吞珍宝变卖。芸妃被贬成宫女慕芸，其后被发现弃尸荷花池内，伊兰被指有杀人嫌疑；太后表示不想冤枉好人，限伊兰三天内证明自己清白。伊兰与道光质问沅宛曾否到访慕芸寝宫。

programme.title: 扑水冤家#17[粤]
programme.desc: 浩琛拒绝接听善美的来电，翌日善美一早跑上吴娇家找浩琛，浩琛表示喜朗及喜宁前往露营，善美不信致电报警，令浩琛见工失败。善美知浩琛打算争夺两名儿女的抚养权，哭成泪人，君祖安慰。浩琛帮忙在的士上结识的Ruby送电脑，看见客人留难Ruby，即替她解围。Ruby看中浩琛对电脑的专业知识，邀请他加盟其公司，浩琛答应。住政发现慧晴与浩仁的合照，拉慧晴到常满家向浩仁大兴问罪。浩琛帮Ruby挽回一名大客的生意，Ruby请浩琛食饭答谢，却被浩琛碰见善美跟君祖在一起，二人有讲有笑。

programme.title: 扑水冤家#18[粤]
programme.desc: 君祖送了二十万股票给善美，并想趁机向善美表白，却被喜朗所阻。浩琛终说服Ruby按楼来争取一大型电脑牌子的代理权，却在银行遇见善美买卖股票，大感错愕。世良相约慧晴、浩仁等前往澳门游玩，浩仁再三推却，慧晴不明因由跟他吵起来。文昌将浩仁替浩琛还债的事告知慧晴，慧晴终谅解浩仁，二人感情更进一步。君祖帮善美租屋及替她请工人打理家务，善美生疑向少芬倾诉。Ruby在浩琛的协助下，成功取得该电脑牌子的代理权。善美无意中得知君祖欲带她到澳门度假，当君祖有意向善美表白之际，善美被吓得弃车而逃。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-东方之珠#14[粤]
programme.desc: 威余气未消，称要拍厕纸广告，再与丰闹翻；威到场后被通知改拍脚癣药膏广告，威本想推辞，但后却改变主意。及后娟表示欲出资助出唱片，被丰婉拒，威却抢过支票表示代为安排。升表示欲安排兰上台演唱，兰未有答允；兰意外遇上成为甜品店老板的阿旺，更表示愿下嫁他，吉力反对但不果。燕与兰到大学找康，但未能劝服返家，燕感怀倾诉往事，令兰感动不已，加上竟收到歌迷来信鼓励，终于令兰重拾信心，决定以唱歌为业。原来歌迷信之中，亦有丰为鼓励兰而写的信；娟为帮丰出唱片尽心尽力，但卖首饰套现却险被丈夫发现。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-东方之珠#15[粤]
programme.desc: 丰得娟之助，终可以灌录首张个人大碟；威欲追求郭小莹，却失败而回。丰因怕娟误会，决定与她划清界线，但威却反刻意令娟误会，借口丰需要资金周转，实情是拿娟钱买名车追求莹。色士风手因病缺阵，吉请缨代行，技术超群大出各人意料，更受丰之托帮忙作曲。燕为安排兰在西班牙领事前一呜惊人，拜会著名拉丁舞大师，不料原来竟是昔日旧情敌白璐。璐不但与燕爱上同一个男人，更因意外破相而对燕怀恨在心；燕为求教不惜硬接一巴掌，兰不忍之下舍身挡下。是夜，燕回忆过去哼出亡夫所作之曲，却意外为宿醉中的吉听到……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#31[粤]
programme.desc: 珊于会议上建议介绍投资过亿的新度假屋，众人以为有机会亲身采访，岂料珊说自己已享用过，众人感没趣推辞跟进稿件，最后责任落在和身上。拉到候选「十大清洁食肆」的酒楼访问被拒，最后得珊帮助完成；但拉在报道上指出该酒楼有老鼠，珊气结。和以储有电脑病毒的USB储存装置交予儿，结果儿被珊责罚把稿件重写。珊要儿追问高有关下季预算报告，高把USB储存装置交予儿，再乘儿忙得不可开交时把装置取回。此时肚痛的好请儿陪她看医生，而珊则要儿替自己回家取文件，儿将珊的门匙交予拉。当拉启动珊的电脑……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#32[粤]
programme.desc: 仁、高与和与军赌博输给军，三人决定以军家作聚赌地以打断军的旺气，但所输掉的比之前还要多。此时军的同屋主南昌返家，刚好代替准备出发到澳门采访的军，继续赌局。军却再约众人开赌，但高却借词推掉。原来众人欲找逢赌必输的昌。赏、大与保安部开会，因他们发现军竟乘众人不在，拿USB储存装置插进和的电脑，亦发现《爆》周刊的内容竟与《潮》的不谋而合，怀疑军与《爆》周刊私通。赏故意在会议时扬言红色USB储存装置内藏独家专题，并刻意将其遗留在会议室。大跟踪军，果然发现他与昌交收物件……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#33[粤]
programme.desc: 本年度「杰出女员工」选举，由编采部负责点票，仁等人不约而同对以二千多票抛离对手的行政秘书美玲感兴趣。军于电梯巧遇玲，玲发现军注视自己忍不住指责他，然而军向美玲提出合理的解释。午饭时军对失落的琴慰问，令她展露笑容，高等误会军钟情于琴，遂带其回家欲劝他脱离琴的魔掌。当四人步出电梯，和不慎踢到新住客的纸箱，气冲冲地往找新住客大兴问罪时，发现新住客竟是玲。军整夜未回，众人误会他与琴的发展迅速，及后发现军留宿的地方竟是玲新居，羡慕不已……

programme.title: 万凰之王#3[粤]
programme.desc: 沅宛不满瑞亲王撮合道光与伊兰，出言指责，瑞亲王反唇相讥。沅宛欲将道光为保伊兰一命而说谎之事禀报太后，遭母亲倩柔阻止，提醒她先在后宫站稳阵脚。沅宛欲借太后最重视的品茗大会，向后宫众人施下马威。道光知伊兰独爱种花，打算向她请教栽花之道，伊兰以种花作比喻，希望道光知难而退。伊兰为证实宫女彩荞无辜，间接揭发芸妃私吞珍宝变卖。芸妃被贬成宫女慕芸，其后被发现弃尸荷花池内，伊兰被指有杀人嫌疑；太后表示不想冤枉好人，限伊兰三天内证明自己清白。伊兰与道光质问沅宛曾否到访慕芸寝宫。

programme.title: 万凰之王#3[粤]
programme.desc: 沅宛不满瑞亲王撮合道光与伊兰，出言指责，瑞亲王反唇相讥。沅宛欲将道光为保伊兰一命而说谎之事禀报太后，遭母亲倩柔阻止，提醒她先在后宫站稳阵脚。沅宛欲借太后最重视的品茗大会，向后宫众人施下马威。道光知伊兰独爱种花，打算向她请教栽花之道，伊兰以种花作比喻，希望道光知难而退。伊兰为证实宫女彩荞无辜，间接揭发芸妃私吞珍宝变卖。芸妃被贬成宫女慕芸，其后被发现弃尸荷花池内，伊兰被指有杀人嫌疑；太后表示不想冤枉好人，限伊兰三天内证明自己清白。伊兰与道光质问沅宛曾否到访慕芸寝宫。

programme.title: 扑水冤家#17[粤]
programme.desc: 浩琛拒绝接听善美的来电，翌日善美一早跑上吴娇家找浩琛，浩琛表示喜朗及喜宁前往露营，善美不信致电报警，令浩琛见工失败。善美知浩琛打算争夺两名儿女的抚养权，哭成泪人，君祖安慰。浩琛帮忙在的士上结识的Ruby送电脑，看见客人留难Ruby，即替她解围。Ruby看中浩琛对电脑的专业知识，邀请他加盟其公司，浩琛答应。住政发现慧晴与浩仁的合照，拉慧晴到常满家向浩仁大兴问罪。浩琛帮Ruby挽回一名大客的生意，Ruby请浩琛食饭答谢，却被浩琛碰见善美跟君祖在一起，二人有讲有笑。

programme.title: 扑水冤家#18[粤]
programme.desc: 君祖送了二十万股票给善美，并想趁机向善美表白，却被喜朗所阻。浩琛终说服Ruby按楼来争取一大型电脑牌子的代理权，却在银行遇见善美买卖股票，大感错愕。世良相约慧晴、浩仁等前往澳门游玩，浩仁再三推却，慧晴不明因由跟他吵起来。文昌将浩仁替浩琛还债的事告知慧晴，慧晴终谅解浩仁，二人感情更进一步。君祖帮善美租屋及替她请工人打理家务，善美生疑向少芬倾诉。Ruby在浩琛的协助下，成功取得该电脑牌子的代理权。善美无意中得知君祖欲带她到澳门度假，当君祖有意向善美表白之际，善美被吓得弃车而逃。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-东方之珠#14[粤]
programme.desc: 威余气未消，称要拍厕纸广告，再与丰闹翻；威到场后被通知改拍脚癣药膏广告，威本想推辞，但后却改变主意。及后娟表示欲出资助出唱片，被丰婉拒，威却抢过支票表示代为安排。升表示欲安排兰上台演唱，兰未有答允；兰意外遇上成为甜品店老板的阿旺，更表示愿下嫁他，吉力反对但不果。燕与兰到大学找康，但未能劝服返家，燕感怀倾诉往事，令兰感动不已，加上竟收到歌迷来信鼓励，终于令兰重拾信心，决定以唱歌为业。原来歌迷信之中，亦有丰为鼓励兰而写的信；娟为帮丰出唱片尽心尽力，但卖首饰套现却险被丈夫发现。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-东方之珠#15[粤]
programme.desc: 丰得娟之助，终可以灌录首张个人大碟；威欲追求郭小莹，却失败而回。丰因怕娟误会，决定与她划清界线，但威却反刻意令娟误会，借口丰需要资金周转，实情是拿娟钱买名车追求莹。色士风手因病缺阵，吉请缨代行，技术超群大出各人意料，更受丰之托帮忙作曲。燕为安排兰在西班牙领事前一呜惊人，拜会著名拉丁舞大师，不料原来竟是昔日旧情敌白璐。璐不但与燕爱上同一个男人，更因意外破相而对燕怀恨在心；燕为求教不惜硬接一巴掌，兰不忍之下舍身挡下。是夜，燕回忆过去哼出亡夫所作之曲，却意外为宿醉中的吉听到……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#31[粤]
programme.desc: 珊于会议上建议介绍投资过亿的新度假屋，众人以为有机会亲身采访，岂料珊说自己已享用过，众人感没趣推辞跟进稿件，最后责任落在和身上。拉到候选「十大清洁食肆」的酒楼访问被拒，最后得珊帮助完成；但拉在报道上指出该酒楼有老鼠，珊气结。和以储有电脑病毒的USB储存装置交予儿，结果儿被珊责罚把稿件重写。珊要儿追问高有关下季预算报告，高把USB储存装置交予儿，再乘儿忙得不可开交时把装置取回。此时肚痛的好请儿陪她看医生，而珊则要儿替自己回家取文件，儿将珊的门匙交予拉。当拉启动珊的电脑……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#32[粤]
programme.desc: 仁、高与和与军赌博输给军，三人决定以军家作聚赌地以打断军的旺气，但所输掉的比之前还要多。此时军的同屋主南昌返家，刚好代替准备出发到澳门采访的军，继续赌局。军却再约众人开赌，但高却借词推掉。原来众人欲找逢赌必输的昌。赏、大与保安部开会，因他们发现军竟乘众人不在，拿USB储存装置插进和的电脑，亦发现《爆》周刊的内容竟与《潮》的不谋而合，怀疑军与《爆》周刊私通。赏故意在会议时扬言红色USB储存装置内藏独家专题，并刻意将其遗留在会议室。大跟踪军，果然发现他与昌交收物件……

programme.title: 毕打自己人#33[粤]
programme.desc: 本年度「杰出女员工」选举，由编采部负责点票，仁等人不约而同对以二千多票抛离对手的行政秘书美玲感兴趣。军于电梯巧遇玲，玲发现军注视自己忍不住指责他，然而军向美玲提出合理的解释。午饭时军对失落的琴慰问，令她展露笑容，高等误会军钟情于琴，遂带其回家欲劝他脱离琴的魔掌。当四人步出电梯，和不慎踢到新住客的纸箱，气冲冲地往找新住客大兴问罪时，发现新住客竟是玲。军整夜未回，众人误会他与琴的发展迅速，及后发现军留宿的地方竟是玲新居，羡慕不已……

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#1[粤]
programme.desc: 大夫证实珑有孕，延知杰一如自己当年，做了不少冤案，极之担心影响子嗣，珑要杰多积阴德，杰有所感，在富商告丫环一案，竟替虹争取利益，众皆诧异，虹感激。延到法华寺上香，庙内石柱突爆裂，露出骸骨。

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#2[粤]
programme.desc: 延见尸体，杰方知本应有十二兄长，惜全都夭折。杰翻查延当年状师，知是「无尸公案」的轩。义庄突被放火，幸星将骸骨放入水缸内，骸骨得以保存，延大喜。延道出往事，当年尸体失踪，延绞尽脑汁，令九入罪，造成冤案。

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#3[粤]
programme.desc: 延当年推断九谋财害命，凶手儿子星受尽歧视。星知延推断错误，却拒绝杰替之翻案。杰出尽法宝，带星到妓院，星同情燕，以高价投得燕陪伴一个月，杰无奈付钱。东错拿数簿当族谱，星不虞有诈，大受感动，求杰代翻案。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-绝代商骄#14[粤]
programme.desc: 正在怀念母亲的爽，突向淼提议，如她肯无条件服从陪伴自己三天，便答应将一身知识传授给她。祖渐获同事信任；努力服侍爽的淼，竟从睡了的爽口中发现，原来爽一直要她扮演的不是女友，而是他的母亲；当下让淼愤怒不已，决意要好好教训爽……在公司会议上爽借森施计，向葆要求让祖重回办公室工作。回到办公室的祖，发现森面对葆与自己时在应对上的分别，终明白在办公室「生存」的难处。因为葆中止了与泰国最大米商的合作，祖要与森一起赶工有关购入印尼米的计划，因此明白了办公室偷工减料的工作方式。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-绝代商骄#15[粤]
programme.desc: 祖得知泰国最大米商察猜将与竞争对手签约后，得到爽鼓励下决定使出自己的「演技」去说服猜……青竟向爽说他是自己儿子，但爽却坚决否认。祖看到爽在街上百无聊赖遂陪他打发时间；爽与祖提起有关自己童年。青约爽见面，更向儿子说出当年自己离开的真正原因。国际炒家Hunter之子Leo到达香港，更高调说对米业前景看好……Leo主动到食家米业与祖等人见面提出收购合并，但被葆拒绝；Leo将旗下的米大幅割价倾销，祖与爽一起见言，希望取得他的支持对付收购战。米价突然猛泻，市民买米狂热中。

programme.title: 特技人#4[粤]
programme.desc: 知行想起与父争执，愤而出外流浪往事。昊荣继室严化冰担心知行若返回公司，会令儿子承泽失势。伟楠接到汽车偈油广告，要求知行担任导演，秦臻任女角。知行为钱答应，并邀请颠峰参与，大志却断然拒绝。美姝看到广告故事分镜图，竟私下接了广告。拍摄时逸飞心不在焉，险些酿成意外，大志心知有异。秦臻表现欠佳，知行一句话竟成功引导她入戏，原来秦臻早就认识知行。美姝约大志到楼上咖啡店，还精心炮制蛋糕，可是等不到大志现身……

programme.title: 特技人#5[粤]
programme.desc: 逸飞被前狱友炯少的手下带走，要求参与不法活动。伟楠为秦臻进行形象塑造，请美姝担任教练，知行负责拍片。美姝看扁秦臻半途而废，怎料秦臻可以坚持到底。知行称赞美姝父常金峰是一代特技人，美姝开心说视父亲为超级巨星。知行向伟楠透露当日被绑架的事，决定拍一部讲述特技人的电影以解心结，伟楠答应寻找投资者。大志见知行刻意接近美姝，出言警告。大志扶着受伤的逸飞跑回车房，警方追至……

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#1[粤]
programme.desc: 大夫证实珑有孕，延知杰一如自己当年，做了不少冤案，极之担心影响子嗣，珑要杰多积阴德，杰有所感，在富商告丫环一案，竟替虹争取利益，众皆诧异，虹感激。延到法华寺上香，庙内石柱突爆裂，露出骸骨。

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#2[粤]
programme.desc: 延见尸体，杰方知本应有十二兄长，惜全都夭折。杰翻查延当年状师，知是「无尸公案」的轩。义庄突被放火，幸星将骸骨放入水缸内，骸骨得以保存，延大喜。延道出往事，当年尸体失踪，延绞尽脑汁，令九入罪，造成冤案。

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#3[粤]
programme.desc: 延当年推断九谋财害命，凶手儿子星受尽歧视。星知延推断错误，却拒绝杰替之翻案。杰出尽法宝，带星到妓院，星同情燕，以高价投得燕陪伴一个月，杰无奈付钱。东错拿数簿当族谱，星不虞有诈，大受感动，求杰代翻案。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-绝代商骄#14[粤]
programme.desc: 正在怀念母亲的爽，突向淼提议，如她肯无条件服从陪伴自己三天，便答应将一身知识传授给她。祖渐获同事信任；���力服侍爽的淼，竟从睡了的爽口中发现，原来爽一直要她扮演的不是女友，而是他的母亲；当下让淼愤怒不已，决意要好好教训爽……在公司会议上爽借森施计，向葆要求让祖重回办公室工作。回到办公室的祖，发现森面对葆与自己时在应对上的分别，终明白在办公室「生存」的难处。因为葆中止了与泰国最大米商的合作，祖要与森一起赶工有关购入印尼米的计划，因此明白了办公室偷工减料的工作方式。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-绝代商骄#15[粤]
programme.desc: 祖得知泰国最大米商察猜将与竞争对手签约后，得到爽鼓励下决定使出自己的「演技」去说服猜……青竟向爽说他是自己儿子，但爽却坚决否认。祖看到爽在街上百无聊赖遂陪他打发时间；爽与祖提起有关自己童年。青约爽见面，更向儿子说出当年自己离开的真正原因。国际炒家Hunter之子Leo到达香港，更高调说对米业前景看好……Leo主动到食家米业与祖等人见面提出收购合并，但被葆拒绝；Leo将旗下的米大幅割价倾销，祖与爽一起见言，希望取得他的支持对付收购战。米价突然猛泻，市民买米狂热中。

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#4[粤]
programme.desc: 杰点灯之际，竟被人换了火药，灯笼爆炸。杰迫县官接受此案，县官称要有当年主审正之批文，正答应，杰被正言辞气度所折服。七日当日，珑收信，赴约与乔见面，当年珑曾救乔，并赠金乔上京赴考，乔感激万分。

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#5[粤]
programme.desc: 乔得知珑已为人妇，极伤心，珑为安慰乔，竟狂踩杰至一文不值。正派乔审星此案，杰发现乔乃与珑相见之男子，辱骂乔，被罚打三十大板。杰求星翻案，星要求杰从楼头跳下。杰拉珑在祖宗面前跪下，珑招认，杰在楼头跳下。

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#6[粤]
programme.desc: 星决翻案，杰以尸骨熬汤，证明乃轩尸体。珑见乔，决以后不再见面。杰寻当年四名证人，觉不肯出庭作证旧事重提，二及根已迁移，只有忠仍留在广州。杰到访，只见忠家满是灰尘，墙上写满「二两」二字。杰险被杀手所伤。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-绝代商骄#16[粤]
programme.desc: 言因葆的工作及私生活而与她争执，却因激动过度晕倒送院；言传话将CEO位置暂时悬空，更将葆调任森的助理；青欲开解女儿反变争执。得翘说项，葆在推举森成为CEO。森提出有财团欲注资入公司，但祖得爽指出，发现森其实是与Leo的合作伙伴倾谈注资，于是偕爽前往阻止。祖指操控森的葆欲出卖公司，令她百辞莫辩。森被撤职后祖成为了CEO，他更想出欲开展米的副食品的计划。爽约淼喝酒，两人喝通宵后淼留家休息；独自回公司的爽突然向祖表示，已约了公司众高层与祖开会，令他手忙脚乱大出洋相。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-绝代商骄#17[粤]
programme.desc: 言突然在会议出现，令根本没有准备的祖表现更差；祖大呼冤枉，更是爽的阴谋，言被激晕送院。言不理祖反对，决定委任爽成为CEO。祖与葆亦因为被爽的欺压，令姊弟冰释前嫌。爽在深夜突然传召森见面，淼于心不忍主动代兄长见爽。晚上淼辗转反侧，更突然醒觉自己喜欢上爽；可惜面对爽，她又无法在他面前表露出来。爽看到祖两姊弟正商议对抗自己的方法，忍不住对他们大加奚落；葆主动向母亲道歉，更说将会搬回家一起居住；而葆更从青处，得到发展新产品的灵感。祖往探爽，更向他说已成功构思了新产品。

programme.title: 五味人生#17[粤]
programme.desc: 九带春到「吴笃村」暂住，但春出外买菜时发现村民们非善男信女；春坚持离村，两人出发时，却看到众村民正怒气冲冲的出现……事件解决后，九的朋友独眼龙与刀疤强向他们解释「吴笃村」的由来。扬与娣探望岚，更托喜相逢办理将到临的陈专员的洗尘宴；岚欲代春揹起关家运作，却发觉春为省钱无论甚么事都一力承担。在洗尘宴前夕，照仁所介绍的厨师竟突然留书离开；看到天不辞劳苦揹义学学生的父亲下山看病，凤以吻奖励他，却被扬看到。为了让天离开凤，扬要求儿子出国留学；在岚的质问下，扬承认天就是祯之弟永宁。

programme.title: 五味人生#18[粤]
programme.desc: 扬将山写下的自白遗书交给岚与祯看，证明是山犯罪。天得岚之助不用到外国读书，特意买礼物到喜相逢送赠她。当天离开时与润月起冲突，祯竟代天道歉，令他大感不满。春与九在吴笃村开大牌档，却因抢了别人生意，惹来村民臭口祖带同伙伴向春挑衅；最终九与他们大打出手。祯请凤与人相睇，指如她答应给有一百元酬劳；在相睇那天祯竟带天出现……春成功说服祖与他合作经营食肆，结果生意更趋繁盛。九煮菜时误吃下毒物，春为照料他连日陪伴在旁；九康复推出新汤水，众人尝过大赞更指这汤应被称为「夫唱妇随汤」……

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#4[粤]
programme.desc: 杰点灯之际，竟被人换了火药，灯笼爆炸。杰迫县官接受此案，县官称要有当年主审正之批文，正答应，杰被正言辞气度所折服。七日当日，珑收信，赴约与乔见面，当年珑曾救乔，并赠金乔上京赴考，乔感激万分。

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#5[粤]
programme.desc: 乔得知珑已为人妇，极伤心，珑为安慰乔，竟狂踩杰至一文不值。正派乔审星此案，杰发现乔乃与珑相见之男子，辱骂乔，被罚打三十大板。杰求星翻案，星要求杰从楼头跳下。杰拉珑在祖宗面前跪下，珑招认，杰在楼头跳下。

programme.title: 追剧之王-状王宋世杰#6[粤]
programme.desc: 星决翻案，杰以尸骨熬汤，证明乃轩尸体。珑见乔，决以后不再见面。杰寻当年四名证人，觉不肯出庭作证旧事重提，二及根已迁移，只有忠仍留在广州。杰到访，只见忠家满是灰尘，墙上写满「二两」二字。杰险被杀手所伤。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-绝代商骄#16[粤]
programme.desc: 言因葆的工作及私生活而与她争执，却因激动过度晕倒送院；言传话将CEO位置暂时悬空，更将葆调任森的助理；青欲开解女儿反变争执。得翘说项，葆在推举森成为CEO。森提出有财团欲注资入公司，但祖得爽指出，发现森其实是与Leo的合作伙伴倾谈注资，于是偕爽前往阻止。祖指操控森的葆欲出卖公司，令她百辞莫辩。森被撤职后祖成为了CEO，他更想出欲开展米的副食品的计划。爽约淼喝酒，两人喝通宵后淼留家休息；独自回公司的爽突然向祖表示，已约了公司众高层与祖开会，令他手忙脚乱大出洋相。

programme.title: Superstar...佘诗曼-绝代商骄#17[粤]
programme.desc: 言突然在会议出现，令根本没有准备的祖表现更差；祖大呼冤枉，更是爽的阴谋，言被激晕送院。言不理祖反对，决定委任爽成为CEO。祖与葆亦因为被爽的欺压，令姊弟冰释前嫌。爽在深夜突然传召森见面，淼于心不忍主动代兄长见爽。晚上淼辗转反侧，更突然醒觉自己喜欢上爽；可惜面对爽，她又无法在他面前表露出来。爽看到祖两姊弟正商议对抗自己的方法，忍不住对他们大加奚落；葆主动向母亲道歉，更说将会搬回家一起居住；而葆更从青处，得到发展新产品的灵感。祖往探爽，更向他说已成功构思了新产品。

programme.title: 万凰之王 #4 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰往请彩荞帮忙设局，成功引出杀害慕芸的凶手。道光为大臣们加税与减税的方法弄得烦忧，到绵怡的祭室诉苦，伊兰遇上道光，为他提供绵怡从政的座右铭。沅宛向伊兰暗示绵怡骨灰甚有可疑，伊兰多番考证终找到端倪。伊兰向太后提出欲往佛寺小住为清室祈福，绵忻却建议道光将伊兰此行改为到避暑山庄外游。道光为曾误会沅宛，送上精致的饰品向她赔罪，逗得她满心欢喜，其后却知道道光将更为名贵的首饰赐赠伊兰。崔嬷嬷与彩蓝无意中听见，服侍绵怡多年的老太监曾于宫外一条村庄遇上绵怡，伊兰决心出宫寻访。

programme.title: 扑水冤家 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 善美拒绝君祖的爱意，其后更向君祖辞职。善美写信向浩琛道歉，托喜朗交给浩琛，喜朗却以为是离婚律师信，私自把信件撕毁，令善美误会浩琛不肯原谅自己。善美遇见浩琛跟Ruby约会，心感不快。文昌失恋，在同事的相劝下，决讨回小玲欢心，文昌为表示复合诚意，打算每日折一樽幸运星送给小玲。世良放弃高薪厚职，与朋友合资经营搪胶玩具。慧晴因节食不适，晕倒送院，浩仁往医院接她，遇见住政，慧晴为替浩仁解围，讹称怀了他的骨肉。破产处人员查出善美隐瞒从股票买卖中获利，欲对她作出起诉。

programme.title: 扑水冤家 #20 [粤]
programme.desc: (大结局)小玲连续九日收到文昌所送的幸运星，仍骂文昌未够诚意。一贼人在警署胁持小玲逃走，文昌奋身相救受伤，小玲感动。Ruby被验出证实患上乳癌，自暴自弃，浩琛开解她，并答应会陪伴她左右。浩琛知善美遭破产处起诉，忙替她找文昌帮忙，善美大喜。浩琛为了陪Ruby做手术，赶不及到法庭听审，善美失望，更被判即时入狱。三个月后，喜朗、喜宁等接善美出狱，却不见浩琛的踪影。善美出席慧晴的婚宴，得悉浩琛外游未及出席，大感失落。浩琛出现，带善美参观其新居，浩琛遂将真相告知，善美破涕而笑。

programme.title: 东方之珠 #16 [粤]
programme.desc: 吉在酒醒后写成曲谱，丰听后却表示因对母亲有恨意而不想唱，兰找康听取意见，最后写成乐曲谱上歌词。丰试唱后愈发起劲，为报答兰，请她到高级餐厅吃饭之余，更在带她前往野餐时，先以假名于电台点唱，令兰大为感动。另一方面，丰欲约见娟说明前因后果，并准备送回拷贝录音带，威生怕真相败露，不惜报假案以阻二人见面。娟被蒙在鼓里更对丰一往情深，因受丈夫气，娟主动找丰倾诉，丰为免生误会，促威帮忙。威为免先去金主，竟讹称丰是受燕压力而不得已，娟信以为真，因再受龙粗暴对待，娟竟决定要跟丰远走他方。

programme.title: 东方之珠 #17 [粤]
programme.desc: 丰表明心迹，娟失望之下竟然跳楼身亡，龙矢言誓要找出真凶，他之后发现娟挟带私逃，不禁怒不可遏。燕以为丰骗财骗色，欲致电报案，龙手下在化妆间内发现娟遗物，而同一时间，丰亦在洗手间无意中听到娟已死的消息，但未及逃跑已被龙擒著痛打一顿，幸得记者目睹及龙上司制止，才避过一劫。重伤送院的丰责难威，需向公众交待，岂料威见龙后竟推卸责任，讹称后悔介绍娟予丰认识。燕为让兰学习上乘拉丁舞艺，不惜献上利刃让白璐划上同样疤痕雪恨，但始终未能打动其心意；另一方面，凤借康安排丽到游乐场游玩却被识破。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #34 [粤]
programme.desc: 殷赏向闫器提议设庆功宴庆祝《潮》销量报捷，闫器答应在员工餐厅办，并要每人支付一百元。此时汝大突然与殷赏争吵，闫器看穿两人的计划，有所领悟，决定付五万元作膳食资助。迪高见乐儿拿著装有五万元的公文袋，提醒她应该保持低调，遂以照片袋代替公文袋。冰冰带同生病的狗只上班，尧坚见素珊未有怪责，深感不忿。乐儿往取鲍鱼庆功，发现袋中物竟是广告照片；当乐儿拿款项赶回鲍鱼店，因时限已过而被拒诸门外；此时冰冰致电素珊称受伤未能出席庆功。鲍鱼店突然送来已付款的到会，乐儿等决定查出幕后黑手。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #35 [粤]
programme.desc: 闫器特意吩咐厨房炮制美食跟汝大和殷赏在会议室品尝，岂料汝大把气氛弄得尴尬。励军等兴高采烈地讨论新专栏的首位嘉宾叶志如，此时尧坚接到通知，汝大与志如在影楼起争执。汝大不满志如的工作态度，志如亦对其拍摄风格感到不耐烦。及后志如怀疑汝大是自己的儿时玩伴，遂向殷赏求证。志如重返影楼，对汝大的要求表现合作，当拍摄完成后志如邀约汝大看歌剧。此时汝大才发现志如判若两人的原因。汝大使计把殷赏骗到员工餐厅，众人也纷纷赶至。汝大当众拒绝志如的邀请后，竟向殷赏表明心迹，殷赏尴尬不已……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #36 [粤]
programme.desc: 殷赏邀请到杰出华人企业家，素珊的第三任前夫上官金雄接受访问，但却被其未婚妻又甜破坏。素珊以大股东身分出席《清爽》杂志聚餐，却发现理忠是该杂志的副总编辑。理忠向素珊提到杂志两年前曾与殷赏签了部头合约但却没有完成任何工作。翌日闫器开会时表示收到《清爽》杂志的律师信，要求殷赏暂停现有的主编工作。又甜突然到素珊家要求她三天之内搬离。原来金雄曾答应她可以住上一辈子，又甜的嚣张使素珊气结。素珊上班后即要尧坚为她找地方搬，殷赏无意中知道个中原因，决定暗中相助……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #4 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰往请彩荞帮忙设局，成功引出杀害慕芸的凶手。道光为大臣们加税与减税的方法弄得烦忧，到绵怡的祭室诉苦，伊兰遇上道光，为他提供绵怡从政的座右铭。沅宛向伊兰暗示绵怡骨灰甚有可疑，伊兰多番考证终找到端倪。伊兰向太后提出欲往佛寺小住为清室祈福，绵忻却建议道光将伊兰此行改为到避暑山庄外游。道光为曾误会沅宛，送上精致的饰品向她赔罪，逗得她满心欢喜，其后却知道道光将更为名贵的首饰赐赠伊兰。崔嬷嬷与彩蓝无意中听见，服侍绵怡多年的老太监曾于宫外一条村庄遇上绵怡，伊兰决心出宫寻访。

programme.desc: 殷赏向闫器提议设庆功宴庆祝《潮》销量报捷，闫器答应在员工餐厅办，并要每人支付一百元。此时汝大突然与殷赏争吵，闫器看穿两人的计划，有所领悟，决定付五万元作膳食资助。迪高见乐儿拿著装有五万元的公文袋，提醒她应该保持低调，遂以照片袋代替公文袋。冰冰带同生病的狗只上班，尧坚见素珊未有怪责，深感不忿。乐儿往取鲍鱼庆功，发现袋中物竟是广告照片；当乐儿拿款项赶回鲍鱼店，因时限已过而被拒诸门外；此时冰冰致电素珊称受伤未能出席庆功。鲍鱼店突然送来已付款的到会，乐儿等决定查出幕后黑手。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #35 [粤]
programme.desc: 闫器特意吩咐厨房炮制美食跟汝大和殷赏在会议室品尝，岂料汝大把气氛弄得尴尬。励军等兴高采烈地讨论新专栏的首位嘉宾叶志如，此时尧坚接到通知，汝大与志如在影楼起争执。汝大不满志如的工作态度，志如亦对其拍摄风格感到不耐烦。及后志如怀疑汝大是自己的儿时玩伴，遂向殷赏求证。志如重返影楼，对汝大的要求表现合作，当拍摄完成后志如邀约汝大看歌剧。此时汝大才发现志如判若两人的原因。汝大使计把殷赏骗到员工餐厅，众人也纷纷赶至。汝大当众拒绝志如的邀请后，竟向殷赏表明心迹，殷赏尴尬不已……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #36 [粤]
programme.desc: 殷赏邀请到杰出华人企业家，素珊的第三任前夫上官金雄接受访问，但却被其未婚妻又甜破坏。素珊以大股东身分出席《清爽》杂志聚餐，却发现理忠是该杂志的副总编辑。理忠向素珊提到杂志两年前曾与殷赏签了部头合约但却没有完成任何工作。翌日闫器开会时表示收到《清爽》杂志的律师信，要求殷赏暂停现有的主编工作。又甜突然到素珊家要求她三天之内搬离。原来金雄曾答应她可以住上一辈子，又甜的嚣张使素珊气结。素珊上班后即要尧坚为她找地方搬，殷赏无意中知道个中原因，决定暗中相助……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #4 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰往请彩荞帮忙设局，成功引出杀害慕芸的凶手。道光为大臣们加税与减税的方法弄得烦忧，到绵怡的祭室诉苦，伊兰遇上道光，为他提供绵怡从政的座右铭。沅宛向伊兰暗示绵怡骨灰甚有可疑，伊兰多番考证终找到端倪。伊兰向太后提出欲往佛寺小住为清室祈福，绵忻却建议道光将伊兰此行改为到避暑山庄外游。道光为曾误会沅宛，送上精致的饰品向她赔罪，逗得她满心欢喜，其后却知道道光将更为名贵的首饰赐赠伊兰。崔嬷嬷与彩蓝无意中听见，服侍绵怡多年的老太监曾于宫外一条村庄遇上绵怡，伊兰决心出宫寻访。

programme.title: 扑水冤家 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 善美拒绝君祖的爱意，其后更向君祖辞职。善美写信向浩琛道歉，托喜朗交给浩琛，喜朗却以为是离婚律师信，私自把信件撕毁，令善美误会浩琛不肯原谅自己。善美遇见浩琛跟Ruby约会，心感不快。文昌失恋，在同事的相劝下，决讨回小玲欢心，文昌为表示复合诚意，打算每日折一樽幸运星送给小玲。世良放弃高薪厚职，与朋友合资经营搪胶玩具。慧晴因节食不适，晕倒送院，浩仁往医院接她，遇见住政，慧晴为替浩仁解围，讹称怀了他的骨肉。破产处人员查出善美隐瞒从股票买卖中获利，欲对她作出起诉。

programme.title: 扑水冤家 #20 [粤]
programme.desc: (大结局)小玲连续九日收到文昌所送的幸运星，仍骂文昌未够诚意。一贼人在警署胁持小玲逃走，文昌奋身相救受伤，小玲感动。Ruby被验出证实患上乳癌，自暴自弃，浩琛开解她，并答应会陪伴她左右。浩琛知善美遭破产处起诉，忙替她找文昌帮忙，善美大喜。浩琛为了陪Ruby做手术，赶不及到法庭听审，善美失望，更被判即时入狱。三个月后，喜朗、喜宁等接善美出狱，却不见浩琛的踪影。善美出席慧晴的婚宴，得悉浩琛外游未及出席，大感失落。浩琛出现，带善美参观其新居，浩琛遂将真相告知，善美破涕而笑。

programme.title: 东方之珠 #16 [粤]
programme.desc: 吉在酒醒后写成曲谱，丰听后却表示因对母亲有恨意而不想唱，兰找康听取意见，最后写成乐曲谱上歌词。丰试唱后愈发起劲，为报答兰，请她到高级餐厅吃饭之余，更在带她前往野餐时，先以假名于电台点唱，令兰大为感动。另一方面，丰欲约见娟说明前因后果，并准备送回拷贝录音带，威生怕真相败露，不惜报假案以阻二人见面。娟被蒙在鼓里更对丰一往情深，因受丈夫气，娟主动找丰倾诉，丰为免生误会，促威帮忙。威为免先去金主，竟讹称丰是受燕压力而不得已，娟信以为真，因再受龙粗暴对待，娟竟决定要跟丰远走他方。

programme.title: 东方之珠 #17 [粤]
programme.desc: 丰表明心迹，娟失望之下竟然跳楼身亡，龙矢言誓要找出真凶，他之后发现娟挟带私逃，不禁怒不可遏。燕以为丰骗财骗色，欲致电报案，龙手下在化妆间内发现娟遗物，而同一时间，丰亦在洗手间无意中听到娟已死的消息，但未及逃跑已被龙擒著痛打一顿，幸得记者目睹及龙上司制止，才避过一劫。重伤送院的丰责难威，需向公众交待，岂料威见龙后竟推卸责任，讹称后悔介绍娟予丰认识。燕为让兰学习上乘拉丁舞艺，不惜献上利刃让白璐划上同样疤痕雪恨，但始终未能打动其心意；另一方面，凤借康安排丽到游乐场游玩却被识破。

programme.title: 万凰之王 #5 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰答应跟随道光往避暑山庄外游；彩蓝向沅宛报告伊兰打算，沅宛命彩蓝送伊兰送她到该疫村，好让她一去不回。当到达避暑山庄时，舒明阿指附近堤道失修，希望道光能御驾鼓励灾民，伊兰与彩蓝把握机会逃离山庄。大臣穆章阿报告金元村的疫情严重，道光等人赶至金元村惊见尸骸遍野，道光更在地上发现伊兰的玉珮。绵忻相约大臣议政事，突然设宴款待众人，并向众人提问「何谓贤臣」，清廉的忠臣颐龄回答后获绵忻力赞；绵忻突然召见卫公公，并当众揭发他中饱私囊的罪证；道光在村中觅得伊兰，透露曾下旨于三天后烧村。

programme.title: 双面伊人 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 姚乐天昏迷八个月，醒后变成失忆。天脑中闪过一红衣女郎坐在车内与自己挥手及亲热的片段，当天见到莫一鸣的座驾跟红衣女子所坐是同一款式时，天对鸣死缠不放，望找到红衣女子下落。天帮做星探的鸣拍了一辑广告而赚钱，鸣认为天是可做之才，为了挽留天，假意替天找红衣女郎，更让天暂住家中。鸣旧同学龙特威是一名警察，接手处理天个案。天忆起以往经常顶撞父姚健明，又记起意外当日，与林静、静父林耀安和明所坐的游艇爆炸，明与安死，天因此昏迷。天往坟埸拜父，遇见静。

programme.title: 双面伊人 #2 [粤]
programme.desc: 天在坟埸遇见静，惜静已乘的士离去。天知静与方德信刚从外地返港，却未能找到二人。威凭资料告诉天，静与信是天好友，天母早逝，明世交儿子信，七岁起住在天家，二人情同兄弟，同在电脑游戏公司内工作。鸣本想问父莫梅借钱，梅却误以为鸣欠大耳窿钱被捉，将身家给了骗徒。鸣为求赚钱，骗天拍黄色刊物封面照，但最终内心歉疚，找威将天从影楼救出。天终重遇信，信带天返家，静见天康复，激动紧拥天，然后竟一手穿进信臂弯，天被二人亲密举动吓呆。

programme.title: 东方之珠 #18 [粤]
programme.desc: 菲怀有升骨肉，部署入主常家当少奶，更借机奚落凤。凤向娇、燕等倾诉，燕闻言建议离婚，凤却说不想丽失去父亲。丽得知母亲苦衷，主动与凤倾谈，虽得升亦保证不会动摇到其爱女的地位，丽在包下全场的荔德中仍然郁郁寡欢，直至康出现陪伴开解，才再度展露笑容。另一方面，璐揭发兰的舞蹈老师一知半解胡乱授舞，燕见状趁势跪求，终打动璐收兰为徒，传授正宗西班牙舞步。兰见丰的唱片受丑闻困扰而滞销，不惜要吉买下唱片铺所有存货，兰演出时心情紧张，得吉告之丰消息与鼓励之后，竟不药而愈。

programme.title: 东方之珠 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 丰冒险到东方之珠捧场，惜与兰缘悭一面，更被升辞退，兰成功演出后得知丰被辞退，想替丰求情，升竟伪善地称二人仍是朋友。菲获安排在别墅养胎，而兰却得陪荔德的太子爷区荔志喝酒，更被借故毛手毛脚，兰藉酒醉呕吐作为报复。威的跑车因欠供款而被拖走，复被同居女友莹赶走，不料却因瓦斯爆炸意外，让威扮成痴心情圣成为传媒焦点。燕因爱儿的长明灯再被丰弄熄，一气下说出自己是告密者。兰连寄十多封信去电台点唱，终搏得播放丰的歌曲，燕终发现是亡夫所作乐曲，追问之下方知丰战时被拐带卖到围村。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #37 [粤]
programme.desc: 绮琴与尧坚往购物，被售货员轻视感不忿；独自回该店时遇上同和与该售货员理论，误会同和为自己与店员起争执。绮琴向励军表示自己突然有恋爱的感觉，请求励军帮她追求同和。励军邀约众男到「好玩吧」，更道出绮琴对同和感兴趣，众男随即使计将她骗走。同和质问励军，反被励军教训，才恍然绮琴有所误会。迪高受命使绮琴知难而退，但竟利用绮琴来当钟点工人。众男向大德诉苦，此时励军突然道出他已设局令绮琴知难而退。当绮琴看到同和电脑中的一辑照片后，决定策划一连串接近同和方法，包括成为众男的邻居……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #38 [粤]
programme.desc: 国仁答应殷赏接载继好和乐儿后便回《潮》出席会议，但午饭时仍未见影踪。国仁回来解释驾车时被高空堕下的鸡蛋遮盖视线而发生车祸，但众人均感难以置信。丽薇把一则空中飞蛋导致途人失忆的新闻递上，汝大发现相中人正是家升。殷赏对「飞蛋失忆事件」感兴趣，遂跟随汝大到医院探望家升。为了取得更多资料，殷赏向家升的主诊医生打听，因此认识家升的友人陈得喜。殷赏向汝大指出家升是假装失忆，却被家升一一击破。殷赏努力调查下终于有所发现；欲以此为封面报道，却接到电话发现家升竟与金波集团有瓜葛……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #39 [粤]
programme.desc: 汝大认为丽薇只会对有利可图之事感兴趣，故对她多次关心家升感好奇，汝大终发现丽薇利用《潮》去证实家升是否伪装失忆的真正原因。素珊不满因接下的肉肠广告在公开的排名榜居于榜尾，于是找来闫器品评味道，但殷赏阻止，终导致肉肠客户与《潮》终止合作。冰冰找到五十万楼盘广告客人，但发现编采部正准备报道其水管出现问题，素珊决定隐瞒至截稿日。闫器得知此事后不欲损失五十万，汝大苦口婆心地劝谏，反被闫器用以退为进的方式，成功令汝大答应出任《潮》社长一职……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #5 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰答应跟随道光往避暑山庄外游；彩蓝向沅宛报告伊兰打算，沅宛命彩蓝送伊兰送她到该疫村，好让她一去不回。当到达避暑山庄时，舒明阿指附近堤道失修，希望道光能御驾鼓励灾民，伊兰与彩蓝把握机会逃离山庄。大臣穆章阿报告金元村的疫情严重，道光等人赶至金元村惊见尸骸遍野，道光更在地上发现伊兰的玉珮。绵忻相约大臣议政事，突然设宴款待众人，并向众人提问「何谓贤臣」，清廉的忠臣颐龄回答后获绵忻力赞；绵忻突然召见卫公公，并当众揭发他中饱私囊的罪证；道光在村中觅得伊兰，透露曾下旨于三天后烧村。

programme.title: 双面伊人 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 姚乐天昏迷八个月，醒后变成失忆。天脑中闪过一红衣女郎坐在车内与自己挥手及亲热的片段，当天见到莫一鸣的座驾跟红衣女子所坐是同一款式时，天对鸣死缠不放，望找到红衣女子下落。天帮做星探的鸣拍了一辑广告而赚钱，鸣认为天是可做之才，为了挽留天，假意替天找红衣女郎，更让天暂住家中。鸣旧同学龙特威是一名警察，接手处理天个案。天忆起以往经常顶撞父姚健明，又记起意外当日，与林静、静父林耀安和明所坐的游艇爆炸，明与安死，天因此昏迷。天往坟埸拜父，遇见静。

programme.title: 双面伊人 #2 [粤]
programme.desc: 天在坟埸遇见静，惜静已乘的士离去。天知静与方德信刚从外地返港，却未能找到二人。威凭资料告诉天，静与信是天好友，天母早逝，明世交儿子信，七岁起住在天家，二人情同兄弟，同在电脑游戏公司内工作。鸣本想问父莫梅借钱，梅却误以为鸣欠大耳窿钱被捉，将身家给了骗徒。鸣为求赚钱，骗天拍黄色刊物封面照，但最终内心歉疚，找威将天从影楼救出。天终重遇信，信带天返家，静见天康复，激动紧拥天，然后竟一手穿进信臂弯，天被二人亲密举动吓呆。

programme.title: 东方之珠 #18 [粤]
programme.desc: 菲怀有升骨肉，部署入主常家当少奶，更借机奚落凤。凤向娇、燕等倾诉，燕闻言建议离婚，凤却说不想丽失去父亲。丽得知母亲苦衷，主动与凤倾谈，虽得升亦保证不会动摇到其爱女的地位，丽在包下全场的荔德中仍然郁郁寡欢，直至康出现陪伴开解，才再度展露笑容。另一方面，璐揭发兰的舞蹈老师一知半解胡乱授舞，燕见状趁势跪求，终打动璐收兰为徒，传授正宗西班牙舞步。兰见丰的唱片受丑闻困扰而滞销，不惜要吉买下唱片铺所有存货，兰演出时心情紧张，得吉告之丰消息与鼓励之后，竟不药而愈。

programme.title: 东方之珠 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 丰冒险到东方之珠捧场，惜与兰缘悭一面，更被升辞退，兰成功演出后得知丰被辞退，想替丰求情，升竟伪善地称二人仍是朋友。菲获安排在别墅养胎，而兰却得陪荔德的太子爷区荔志喝酒，更被借故毛手毛脚，兰藉酒醉呕吐作为报复。威的跑车因欠供款而被拖走，复被同居女友莹赶走，不料却因瓦斯爆炸意外，让威扮成痴心情圣成为传媒焦点。燕因爱儿的长明灯再被丰弄熄，一气下说出自己是告密者。兰连寄十多封信去电台点唱，终搏得播放丰的歌曲，燕终发现是亡夫所作乐曲，追问之下方知丰战时被拐带卖到围村。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #37 [粤]
programme.desc: 绮琴与尧坚往购物，被售货员轻视感不忿；独自回该店时遇上同和与该售货员理论，误会同和为自己与店员起争执。绮琴向励军表示自己突然有恋爱的感觉，请求励军帮她追求同和。励军邀约众男到「好玩吧」，更道出绮琴对同和感兴趣，众男随即使计将她骗走。同和质问励军，反被励军教训，才恍然绮琴有所误会。迪高受命使绮琴知难而退，但竟利用绮琴来当钟点工人。众男向大德诉苦，此时励军突然道出他已设局令绮琴知难而退。当绮琴看到同和电脑中的一辑照片后，决定策划一连串接近同和方法，包括成为众男的邻居……

programme.desc: 菲怀有升骨肉，部署入主常家当少奶，更借机奚落凤。凤向娇、燕等倾诉，燕闻言建议离婚，凤却说不想丽失去父亲。丽得知母亲苦衷，主动与凤倾谈，虽得升亦保证不会动摇到其爱女的地位，丽在包下全场的荔德中仍然郁郁寡欢，直至康出现陪伴开解，才再度展露笑容。另一方面，璐揭发兰的舞蹈老师一知半解胡乱授舞，燕见状趁势跪求，终打动璐收兰为徒，传授正宗西班牙舞步。兰见丰的唱片受丑闻困扰而滞销，不惜要吉买下唱片铺所有存货，兰演出时心情紧张，得吉告之丰消息与鼓励之后，竟不药而愈。

programme.title: 东方之珠 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 丰冒险到东方之珠捧场，惜与兰缘悭一面，更被升辞退，兰成功演出后得知丰被辞退，想替丰求情，升竟伪善地称二人仍是朋友。菲获安排在别墅养胎，而兰却得陪荔德的太子爷区荔志喝酒，更被借故毛手毛脚，兰藉酒醉呕吐作为报复。威的跑车因欠供款而被拖走，复被同居女友莹赶走，不料却因瓦斯爆炸意外，让威扮成痴心情圣成为传媒焦点。燕因爱儿的长明灯再被丰弄熄，一气下说出自己是告密者。兰连寄十多封信去电台点唱，终搏得播放丰的歌曲，燕终发现是亡夫所作乐曲，追问之下方知丰战时被拐带卖到围村。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #38 [粤]
programme.desc: 国仁答应殷赏接载继好和乐儿后便回《潮》出席会议，但午饭时仍未见影踪。国仁回来解释驾车时被高空堕下的鸡蛋遮盖视线而发生车祸，但众人均感难以置信。丽薇把一则空中飞蛋导致途人失忆的新闻递上，汝大发现相中人正是家升。殷赏对「飞蛋失忆事件」感兴趣，遂跟随汝大到医院探望家升。为了取得更多资料，殷赏向家升的主诊医生打听，因此认识家升的友人陈得喜。殷赏向汝大指出家升是假装失忆，却被家升一一击破。殷赏努力调查下终于有所发现；欲以此为封面报道，却接到电话发现家升竟与金波集团有瓜葛……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #39 [粤]
programme.desc: 汝大认为丽薇只会对有利可图之事感兴趣，故对她多次关心家升感好奇，汝大终发现丽薇利用《潮》去证实家升是否伪装失忆的真正原因。素珊不满因接下的肉肠广告在公开的排名榜居于榜尾，于是找来闫器品评味道，但殷赏阻止，终导致肉肠客户与《潮》终止合作。冰冰找到五十万楼盘广告客人，但发现编采部正准备报道其水管出现问题，素珊决定隐瞒至截稿日。闫器得知此事后不欲损失五十万，汝大苦口婆心地劝谏，反被闫器用以退为进的方式，成功令汝大答应出任《潮》社长一职……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #5 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰答应跟随道光往避暑山庄外游；彩蓝向沅宛报告伊兰打算，沅宛命彩蓝送伊兰送她到该疫村，好让她一去不回。当到达避暑山庄时，舒明阿指附近堤道失修，希望道光能御驾鼓励灾民，伊兰与彩蓝把握机会逃离山庄。大臣穆章阿报告金元村的疫情严重，道光等人赶至金元村惊见尸骸遍野，道光更在地上发现伊兰的玉珮。绵忻相约大臣议政事，突然设宴款待众人，并向众人提问「何谓贤臣」，清廉的忠臣颐龄回答后获绵忻力赞；绵忻突然召见卫公公，并当众揭发他中饱私囊的罪证；道光在村中觅得伊兰，透露曾下旨于三天后烧村。

programme.title: 双面伊人 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 姚乐天昏迷八个月，醒后变成失忆。天脑中闪过一红衣女郎坐在车内与自己挥手及亲热的片段，当天见到莫一鸣的座驾跟红衣女子所坐是同一款式时，天对鸣死缠不放，望找到红衣女子下落。天帮做星探的鸣拍了一辑广告而赚钱，鸣认为天是可做之才，为了挽留天，假意替天找红衣女郎，更让天暂住家中。鸣旧同学龙特威是一名警察，接手处理天个案。天忆起以往经常顶撞父姚健明，又记起意外当日，与林静、静父林耀安和明所坐的游艇爆炸，明与安死，天因此昏迷。天往坟埸拜父，遇见静。

programme.title: 双面伊人 #2 [粤]
programme.desc: 天在坟埸遇见静，惜静已乘的士离去。天知静与方德信刚从外地返港，却未能找到二人。威凭资料告诉天，静与信是天好友，天母早逝，明世交儿子信，七岁起住在天家，二人情同兄弟，同在电脑游戏公司内工作。鸣本想问父莫梅借钱，梅却误以为鸣欠大耳窿钱被捉，将身家给了骗徒。鸣为求赚钱，骗天拍黄色刊物封面照，但最终内心歉疚，找威将天从影楼救出。天终重遇信，信带天返家，静见天康复，激动紧拥天，然后竟一手穿进信臂弯，天被二人亲密举动吓呆。

programme.title: Thank You Teacher#13[粤/泰]
programme.desc: 改编自韩剧"Black Dog"。讲述年轻的女教师如何面对学校、社会的不公平，为了成为「真正的老师」，她必须在学校这个战场上坚持，努力寻找自己求生的道路。

programme.title: 谢谢#10[粤/韩]
programme.desc: 以韩国蓝岛为背景，讲述了封闭了内心的出色医生闵基书，和虽然孩子身患艾滋病却依然怀抱着希望勇敢面对生活的李永新，在交往中彼此间创造奇迹的故事。

programme.title: 谢谢 #12 [粤/韩]
programme.desc: 以韩国蓝岛为背景，讲述了封闭了内心的出色医生闵基书，和虽然孩子身患艾滋病却依然怀抱着希望勇敢面对生活的李永新，在交往中彼此间创造奇迹的故事。

programme.title: 我的初创时代 #3 [粤/泰]
programme.desc: 家境贫穷，从小父母离异的Pafun长大后成为勤奋上进的人。她的梦想是成为像史蒂夫‧贾伯斯那样的企业家。 她在Sandbox遇到初恋情人Jiraphat和小时候的笔友Korn。 Pafun 加入 Sandbox 追逐梦想，而Korn则与 Jiraphat 一起创立 Samsan Tech。

programme.title: Thank You Teacher #15 [粤/泰]
programme.desc: 改编自韩剧"Black Dog"。讲述年轻的女教师如何面对学校、社会的不公平，为了成为「真正的老师」，她必须在学校这个战场上坚持，努力寻找自己求生的道路。

programme.desc: 家境贫穷，从小父母离异的Pafun长大后成为勤奋上进的人。她的梦想是成为像史蒂夫‧贾伯斯那样的企业家。 她在Sandbox遇到初恋情人Jiraphat和小时候的笔友Korn。 Pafun 加入 Sandbox 追逐梦想，而Korn则与 Jiraphat 一起创立 Samsan Tech。

programme.title: Thank You Teacher #16 [粤/泰]

programme.title: 亚洲剧台精选 -灿烂的遗产#14[粤/韩]

programme.title: 黄金翡翠台精选 -香港 '83#222[粤]
programme.desc: 威妈来向威哥借钱，他没钱在身，于是拿了收银机内的钱来用。康仔发现收银机少了五百元，威哥回来向众人说出自己借钱的事。康仔发现收银机少了一百元，陈积指证威哥，威哥备受嫌疑，大感冤屈，最后事情终于水落石出。

programme.title: SUPER九点半神剧 -My盛Lady#15[粤]
programme.desc: 袁萱在友情和爱情之间难以取舍；花蕾亦打算放弃广男成全袁萱。广男接受天骄的请求与袁萱交往，袁萱也为广男一改形象。袁萱成为人气歌手替公司接拍宣传片。广男请袁琛放弃善男，袁琛却回应是善男纠缠自己。袁萱为向花蕾示威，偷偷拍下与广男的床照上传给花蕾。袁琛与善男分手，善男认为是广男从中作梗向他大发脾气。袁萱透露不明广男所想，天骄自荐成为她的恋爱顾问。善男大醉，向花蕾透露广男的秘密。

programme.title: 香港原味道[粤]
programme.desc: 《香港原味道》再次出发，主持谭玉瑛、吴幸美、黄庭锋继续四出搜寻香港土炮食材。他们走进本地鱼场、活鸡场、鲜菜园、酱园、炼油厂、老饼家、薯片厂、雪糕厂等，发掘港产食材的第一手本土原味道，细味坚守香港优质食材背后的人情味和故事。三位主持闯入蚝田认识传统养蚝方法、清晨到菜田看本地菜的出售过程，在大澳、流浮山帮忙制作咸鲜等，参与、见证原味生成过程。追味溯源，发扬将近失传的味道与手艺，寻回被遗忘的饮食智慧。

千禧经典台精选 -法证先锋#16[粤]
programme.desc: 隆因涉嫌杀害亲弟而被捕，隆否认指控，期间太过激动以致哮喘病发作。博引导隆，终替他找到时间证人，洗脱嫌疑。琛在中口里发现一枚硬币和少量稀有藏羚羊羊毛，并发现他其实是在泳池毙命。博等遂循此线索追查。博等查出女星金海潮怀有中的骨肉，而潮的姐姐的男友正是中之风水师允天机，博对三人的关系感到怀疑。汀要琛履约比赛吃辣，琛不忍见她受苦而认输，汀高兴得吻了琛一下，琛当场呆住。博发现中死于潮家的泳池，机、潮被带返署问话。柔等终将隆售贼赃案之关键人物John拘捕，John招认一切，隆终脱罪。

programme.title: 千禧经典台精选 -法证先锋#17[粤]
programme.desc: 邦遭盘问，湄深知纸包不住火，只好供出一切，众人不屑中的所作所为。洁决定结束中经营之生意，刚、柔亦劝隆退休。琛发现博、柔常常互相抬杠；另一方面，汀见媛熟知博的喜恶，误会二人拍拖。汀与琛谈及博的新恋情，误会他一脚踏两船。琛回家后质问博，博却坦言尚未准备接受新恋情。媛约博晚饭，博见到媛盛装打扮又似有所暗示时，即表明态度，媛不禁失笑。柔在媛鼓励下约博于酒吧见面。博首先到达，期间看见男子莫卓浩向女伴下迷药，即上前阻止，岂料自己却遭浩的同伴Paul在其饮料中下药。

programme.title: 千禧经典台精选 -法证先锋#18[粤]
programme.desc: 博惊讶与柔发生了关系；柔对博是受药物影响才跟她一夕温存一事却毫不知情。博出现口渴和反应迟缓等现象，琛指这并不正常，博遂暗中拿自己尿液作化验，果然发现其中有药物成份。博著警方到酒吧调查，证实有人交易毒品。柔以为与博关系已迈进一步，春风满面。刚外游回来后，惊闻汀已有男友。博向柔表明心迹，柔闻言强装镇静。刚向琛倾诉感情烦恼后，琛即回避汀，但是为了助一婆婆捉贼，亦只好跟她一同前往新界。二人发现事件竟与婆婆的亲人有关。汀将刚所赠的同款钥匙圈转赠给琛，琛终肯定汀爱上的是自己。

programme.desc: 隆因涉嫌杀害亲弟而被捕，隆否认指控，期间太过激动以致哮喘病发作。博引导隆，终替他找到时间证人，洗脱嫌疑。琛在中口里发现一枚硬币和少量稀有藏羚羊羊毛，并发现他其实是在泳池毙命。博等遂循此线索追查。博等查出女星金海潮怀有中的骨肉，而潮的姐姐的男友正是中之风水师允天机，博对三人的关系感到怀疑。汀要琛履约比赛吃辣，琛不忍见她受苦而认输，汀高兴得吻了琛一下，琛当场呆住。博发现中死于潮家的泳池，机、潮被带返署问话。柔等终将隆售贼赃案之关键人物John拘捕，John招认一切，隆终脱罪。

programme.title: 千禧经典台精选 -法证先锋#17[粤]
programme.desc: 邦遭盘问，湄深知纸包不住火，只好供出一切，众人不屑中的所作所为。洁决定结束中经营之生意，刚、柔亦劝隆退休。琛发现博、柔常常互相抬杠；另一方面，汀见媛熟知博的喜恶，误会二人拍拖。汀与琛谈及博的新恋情，误会他一脚踏两船。琛回家后质问博，博却坦言尚未准备接受新恋情。媛约博晚饭，博见到媛盛装打扮又似有所暗示时，即表明态度，媛不禁失笑。柔在媛鼓励下约博于酒吧见面。博首先到达，期间看见男子莫卓浩向女伴下迷药，即上前阻止，岂料自己却遭浩的同伴Paul在其饮料中下药。

programme.title: 千禧经典台精选 -法证先锋#18[粤]
programme.desc: 博惊讶与柔发生了关系；柔对博是受药物影响才跟她一夕温存一事却毫不知情。博出现口渴和反应迟缓等现象，琛指这并不正常，博遂暗中拿自己尿液作化验，果然发现其中有药物成份。博著警方到酒吧调查，证实有人交易毒品。柔以为与博关系已迈进一步，春风满面。刚外游回来后，惊闻汀已有男友。博向柔表明心迹，柔闻言强装镇静。刚向琛倾诉感情烦恼后，琛即回避汀，但是为了助一婆婆捉贼，亦只好跟她一同前往新界。二人发现事件竟与婆婆的亲人有关。汀将刚所赠的同款钥匙圈转赠给琛，琛终肯定汀爱上的是自己。

programme.title: 香港原味道[粤]
programme.desc: 《香港原味道》再次出发，主持谭玉瑛、吴幸美、黄庭锋继续四出搜寻香港土炮食材。他们走进本地鱼场、活鸡场、鲜菜园、酱园、炼油厂、老饼家、薯片厂、雪糕厂等，发掘港产食材的第一手本土原味道，细味坚守香港优质食材背后的人情味和故事。三位主持闯入蚝田认识传统养蚝方法、清晨到菜田看本地菜的出售过程，在大澳、流浮山帮忙制作咸鲜等，参与、见证原味生成过程。追味溯源，发扬将近失传的味道与手艺，寻回被遗忘的饮食智慧。

programme.title: 出走地图[粤/普]
programme.desc: 梁凯晴、蔡明思前往鹤冈八幡宫祈福，参观镰仓大佛；著名的鸽子签可会带来运气？相连的小町通出售许多大佛精品，逛累了还有满街滋味小食。百年工艺毛巾专卖店，细小方巾藏着职人的匠心，柔软得一摸爱上！登上行山胜地大山，乘缆车到阿夫利神社只需六分钟；主持们细说阿夫利神祇与富士山的渊缘，喝大山神水，祈愿火炉许愿。古屋改建的咖啡店内，二人品尝以山水制作的豆腐松饼，味道清新。她们再于山下老街打陀螺，体验当地传统工艺。

programme.title: 出走地图[粤/普]
programme.desc: 梁凯晴、蔡明思到江之岛以退役车头作店面的和菓子店，不时看到行驶中的江之电。还不够近？在铁道旁的咖啡厅近看触手可及的电车，排队也值得。搭乘松田町迷你小火车，360度观赏和京樱满山花海，品尝扑鼻花香的樱花馒头，还可以用另类方式，穿越梦幻粉红的樱花隧道？二人化身战国人物，述说小田原城的历史。隐藏城内的文青咖啡店，是为了纪念哪位名人？乘坐惊险的单人缆车登上小室山，回报的是绝美景色！还可品尝限定杜鹃花雪糕。

programme.title: 蓝色生死恋#8[韩]
programme.desc: 小时候的尹俊熙因为贪玩把恩熙跟芯爱的名牌弄乱导致护士阴错阳差的把两名婴儿的名牌搞错。原本在幸福美满家庭中长大的俊熙和恩熙兄妹，却在一次车祸中，因为血液检查而得知了真相的恩熙，一夕之间变成了灰姑娘...

programme.title: 锦衣之下 #49 [普]
programme.desc: 六扇门女捕快袁今夏因为一桩案件和锦衣卫陆绎结下梁子,今夏本以为此生与他再无交集,奈何冤家路窄。朝廷十万两修河款不翼而飞,今夏奉命协助陆绎一起下扬州查案,替朝廷找回丢失的官银。本是道不同不相为谋,却因惊天...

programme.title: 法医秦明之读心者 #26 [普]
programme.desc: 该剧根据《法医秦明》系列小说第一部《尸语者》改编。讲述了法医研究生秦明为了调查母亲遇害的谜团，只身来到母亲的老家龙番市，并在此经受历练与成长的故事。

programme.title: 灿烂的遗产 #17 [粤/韩]
programme.desc: 流离失所的高恩诚在偶然机会下救了大财团会长一命，想不到竟被会长视如亲孙女般接返家，更获得遗产继承权。因祸得福的恩诚却因此遭受原本的继承人，会长的嫡孙鲜于焕敌意对待，于焕誓要夺回家族产业的控制权。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #225 [粤]
programme.desc: 顺嫂答应懋叔于他离开期间暂不打麻雀。顺嫂的朋友来找觉悟因睇相，之后与顺嫂倾谈秘密，陈积见顺嫂的朋友意态娇柔，以为她要顺嫂做不正经的勾当。顺嫂时常夜归，众人大感担心，牛太终于爆出顺嫂学唱戏的秘密。

programme.title: My盛Lady #18 [粤]
programme.desc: 罗娜主动解释自己一直失踪的原因。广男十分惧怕罗娜，更说出当年两人认识的原委。花蕾突然收到罗娜的求救电话，因放心不下将罗娜接回家中寄住。翌日罗娜和花蕾家人一起吃早餐，柏坚和花蕊耍花枪，罗娜见柏坚身型健硕不禁心动。花蕾为了帮罗娜改善生活，安排罗娜顶上袁萱以前的工作岗位。罗娜一直垂涎柏坚美色，并情不自禁对柏坚充满幻想；罗娜借故送饭给柏坚，更偷窥柏坚洗澡。柏坚向广男诉苦，广男才告知众人找人查过罗娜的秘密。

programme.title: 锦衣之下 #49 [普]
programme.desc: 六扇门女捕快袁今夏因为一桩案件和锦衣卫陆绎结下梁子,今夏本以为此生与他再无交集,奈何冤家路窄。朝廷十万两修河款不翼而飞,今夏奉命协助陆绎一起下扬州查案,替朝廷找回丢失的官银。本是道不同不相为谋,却因惊天...

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Grey Men

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Paper Man

Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: The Business Boss: Back in Baby
programme.desc: After the events of the Boss Baby 2 film, adult businessman Theodore Templeton is framed for embezzling from his company and forced to revert back to his old Boss Baby self and crash with his brother Tim. But to pull this off, he'll need to win over Tim's family into letting him stay, and convince Baby Corp to give him back his old job... which is currently held by his baby niece Tina.

programme.title: The Stroll
programme.desc: Tina and Boss adjust to co-boss responsibilities while on a mission to rescue the baby with the best hair in the world from a lice outbreak. With opposing leadership views, the two split the existing field team's focus and discover a new archenemy in Lumpy the Park Duck.

programme.title: The New Alliance
programme.desc: A space explorer, previously thought lost in space, returns to Earth and joins four teenagers in a search for a giant alien robot lion

programme.title: From Days Long Ago
programme.desc: The Blue Lion delivers the team to an alien planet where they discover a mysterious castle. Inside, they awaken an alien princess who sends them on a mission to find the remaining lions.

programme.title: Lucky And The Unbreakable Spirit
programme.desc: A wild horse Spirit and a soontobe city girl Lucky become friends in a frontier town

programme.title: Why Hen Pecks The Ground
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hen didn't peck the ground. She was a proud mother who spent all her time looking after and cleaning her chicks. Fancy pancy Peacock upsets Mama Hen and makes her feel plain. All the animals are furious with Snooty Peacock… but the damage has been done. Eagle - Mama Hen's best friend - decides to lend Hen her most prized possession - A needle! And Mama Hen sews herself the most beautiful coat of new feathers. Everyone is delighted and they dance and dance and dance.

programme.title: Why Bat Hangs Upside Down
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Bat didn't hang upside down. He used to fly all over Tinga Tinga, saying ‘Boo!' to all the animals and giving them a fright. Nothing could be more fun for Bat. But one day Bat went too far… and the animals decided to give Bat a dose of his own medicine. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Marsha Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Marsha overhears the others saying she is too bossy. She decides that Silver hatch would be a better place without her. Chaos swiftly ensues, can Marsha be persuaded to stay, they can't cope without her!

programme.title: Let's Hear It For Big Chris
programme.desc: Big Chris is working on Loada while the others plan a surprise evening for him for being the longest serving member of Silver hatch

programme.title: Funny Business
programme.desc: Big Chris receives a mysterious parcel… the cars are intrigued to find out what is in it. Strange and silly things start happening at the workshop, could it have anything to do with Big Chris' package?

programme.title: Nick Solves The Case
programme.desc: PC Pete has been summonsed to get to the bottom of some missing fuel. But where's Nick? And who can solve the case?

programme.title: Simply The Best
programme.desc: Molecom is very grateful to Plugger for rescuing him after yet another of Flash's pranks. But Plugger is soon frustrated by Molecom's attempts to help… Meanwhile, Roary is trying hard to beat his best lap time.

programme.title: Cici Wins The Day
programme.desc: Cici is fed up with never winning and decides not to take part in the race that day. Can Roary persuade her to change her mind?

programme.title: Crabby / Spe-shell
programme.desc: When Pixie’s pet crab goes into a cave, Kelp uses his knowledge of crabs under the sea to coax him out using dance and rhythm. / Scallop’s special shell is broken, but Kelp transforms the broken bits into something even more special.

programme.title: Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.title: He Blinded Me With Science
programme.desc: Julien teams up with Timo, the tenrec, a scientist who the King elists to automate everything in the kingdom.

programme.title: Viva Mort
programme.desc: When Julien embarrasses Maurice, he tries to make up for his transgression, while Mort inadvertently joins an anti-King Julien group.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: Ignition
programme.desc: Shashi finally reveals his master plan.

programme.title: The Key To The Strip
programme.desc: The kids battle Shashi in Las Vegas as Shashi tries to take down evil billionaire Cleve and use Skeleton Key to create a new world order. Frostee has a plan to get Skeleton Key offline, but it only gives Tony ten seconds to take Shashi out and save the world.

programme.title: Ding Dong Day \ Grand Sam
programme.desc: It’s Pawston’s annual Take Your Kid to Work Day, and it’s Tag’s year to spend the day at the Doorbell Store with Paw. \ Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to complete an obstacle course in the woods.

programme.title: Clucky Day \ Take Me Out to the Fetch Game
programme.desc: Scooch is bummed out because he’s missing his favorite holiday back in his old farm town, so Tag wants to cheer him up by rounding up some chickens and bringing Clucky Day to Pawston. \ When there’s a schedule mix-up and the Pawston Get Sox players think they have a day off, it’s up to Tag and Scooch to round up all five players in time for the fetch game, so that they don’t have to forfeit.

programme.title: Mailed Away / The Wandering Wand
programme.desc: When Harper unknowingly drops her cooking camp application on the way to post office, it’s up to the Dew Drops to get it into that big blue mailbox. / When Cassie accidentally places Lola's beloved, old toy wand in a box marked for a giveaway drive in the park, the Dew Drops must find a way to retrieve the wand before it ends up in the hands of an entirely new family.

programme.title: Lucky Penny / Hammy’s Day Out
programme.desc: Marcus has a piano recital and unknowingly forgets his lucky penny at home. Now it’s up to the Dew Drops to get the penny across town and back into Marcus’ pocket before showtime. / When Nicholas rolls the hamster ball (with Hammy inside) out into the streets, the Dew Drops must get Hammy back home safely.

programme.title: Pet Project / Mission Improbable
programme.desc: When Mr. Tanaka adopts an unruly dog at Sam’s behest, the Zenkos have the job of training the mischievous mutt and turning him into man’s best friend material. / When Ellie's friend Maria is late submitting her painting to the art show, it’s up to the Zenkos to get inside the community center after hours, avoiding overzealous junior security Rodney, and get Maria’s painting on display before the show starts.

programme.title: An Inconvenient Tooth / Up, Up and Away
programme.desc: After Lula loses her loose tooth in the park, Team Zenko must find the missing molar and get it under Lula’s pillow in time for the Tooth Fairy’s visit. / Gabriel and Luis show off their new drone but it crash lands on the roof top. Team Zenko's mission is to try and get it back, but Yolanda won't give up her new hi-tech friend that easily.

programme.title: Mixed-Up Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a snow globe shaped like the dollhouse, she notices the rooms inside are all cattywampus and in the wrong place. After a series of wacky misadventures that result in CatRat becoming a craft version of himself, Gabby figures out they need to fix the dollhouse globe to return everything back to normal.

programme.title: Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the "butt xylophone" couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Munk History / Happy Howl Day
programme.desc: Grug tries to solve the mystery of where Munk's family is /Eep refuses to join in when Ahhh! Valley celebrates their first holiday, "Howl Day"

programme.title: Snooty And The Beasts Part 1 & 2
programme.desc: After rescuing Kevin and almost having a first kiss, Eep sets up dangerous situations to recreate the moment; Grug and Snoot go on a rescue/mission

programme.title: The Heat is On
programme.desc: On the hottest week of the year and a miserable time for babies, Boss and Tim infiltrates a country club with a very cool splash pad in order to find some way around their strict "no-babies" policy. Meanwhile, Banker Baby Benny visits the startup company to check on his investment. Tina has to cover up how the heat has split her coworkers into lawless factions fighting over a fan and a mist cooler.

programme.title: One Tricked Pony
programme.desc: An overworked and under loved Precious has to choose between the Templeton Family startup business or Crispin Biscuits’ fun playtime. Meanwhile, the company makes its first purchase: upgraded communicators! R & D Baby Simmons is reluctant to fix the model they have, which picks up signals from her favorite lvorian soap opera, "Bridges Aflame." Over a live broadcast, Simmons must convince the cast to tie up every loose plot thread before she has to lose the signal forever.

programme.title: Reign Of Fireworms
programme.desc: Fireworms invade Dragon's Edge, while Ruffnut and Tuffnut discover that they have an unexpected connection to the island.

programme.title: Crushing It
programme.desc: As a Rumblehorn wreaks havoc on Dragon's Edge, Hiccup seeks the help of Stoick - who forms an unexpected bond with the rampaging beast.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Costly Conundrum of the Calamitous Claylossus
programme.desc: George and Harold transform the school's mysterious student into a giant clay monster who turns the entire town into clay

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Jarring Jerkiness of the Judge J.O.R.T.S
programme.desc: George and Harold transform their new Spanish teacher into a superhero after they feel guilty for pranking him, but their teacher loves it and gets carried away

programme.title: The Arcadian Job
programme.desc: When Aja and Krel learn a secret, military base may house an alien spacecraft, they enlist Stuart to help them infilitrate it. Meanwhile, General Morando unviels his latest weapon - Omen, a deadly, cyborg assassin.

programme.title: Truth Be Told
programme.desc: During her last days on Earth, Aja decides to tell Steve the truth: she's an alien. But her plans are complicated when the Zerons abduct Aja, Steve and Krel. Meanwhile, Vex struggles with an impossible choice: saving the Royal teens or the Royal Cores.

programme.title: Last Night on Earth
programme.desc: With the Mothership ready for liftoff, Aja and Krel celebrate their last day on Earth at Battle of the Bands. But their world is rocked when Zadra arrives with a startling revelation about Vex - and a new enemy threatens their departure.

programme.title: Sitting Ducks
programme.desc: Boss, Tina, JJ, Dez and Pip willfully get babysat by the Uncuddleables, planning to expose them as horrible sitters via secret, hidden cameras. But the plan is thrown for a loop when Tina's first night alone without her parents makes her fall for their sitter Mia as a "substitute mommy." Meanwhile, Nannycam uses the babysitting distraction to sneak into the Uncuddleables' secret garage hideout to gather intel with her own "B field team."

programme.title: The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corp's super-cute top 5%er babies with not-cute bottom 5%ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5%ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5%er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: The Knight's Fall - Part 1
programme.desc: Po and Blade rush to warn the Emperor about the weasels, but he has Po arrested and Colin captures Blade, revealing that she was never a knight. Thrown in a cell, Po reunites with Rukhmini and Mr. Ping, and he copes with the truth about Blade as they break out. Po fights Klaus and Veruca but is outmatched. Blade defeats Colin and hurries to help Po but is too late.

programme.title: The Knight's Fall - Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blade’s life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: The Liar and The Thief
programme.desc: The team arrives in India where an old friend of Rukhmini can supposedly give them a pendant that will lead to the next Tianshang weapon. But when they arrive, they find that Rukhmini’s hometown has changed a lot in the thirty years she’s been gone, and her old friend Diya might not be willing to help them.

programme.title: Welcome Back Otter
programme.desc: Abigail puts herself at risk to reunite an orphaned otter with his family. But the school veterinarian insists the animal will be safer at the zoo.

programme.title: The Palomino Family Affair
programme.desc: Lucky and Bebe spend the weekend pretending to be besties when their fathers come for a family visit and reveal that they're old friends.

programme.title: Back To The Starting Line
programme.desc: As a new term begins, Maricela and her horse, Mystery, arrive at the academy to join Lucky, Pru and Abigail for the school year.

programme.title: Super Smash Siblings / A Hole In Grug
programme.desc: Eep and Thunk compete against their classmates in "Ahhh-Smashin"/After being denied a spot on the Valley's Wall of Fame, Grug creates a new game

programme.title: Bait With Destiny / Sappy Together
programme.desc: Eep gets jealous when Thunk is invited to join the hunters/Grug and Gran must work together after getting stuck to each other with sticky tree sap

programme.title: Scare Tactics / Disturbiahhh!
programme.desc: Grug has Thunk use "scare tactics" to get the Valley to defend against the Broods/Eep thinks Snoot is holding Ahhh! Valleyites captive in his cave

programme.title: Have Dragon Will Travel Pt 1
programme.desc: The Dragon Riders are surprised to discover who is behind recent attacks on nearby ships - and to learn exactly what the ships are.

programme.title: Have Dragon Will Travel Pt 2
programme.desc: Heather joins the Dragon Riders, but it's not an easy alliance, especially when Hiccup uncovers a shocking secret about her true identity.

programme.title: The Next Big Sting
programme.desc: Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders rescue a wounded Speed Stinger and take it back to Dragon's Edge, unaware of the dangers that follow.

programme.title: The Reckless Club
programme.desc: Jim and his friends are trapped in detention while tensions in Trollmarket escalate with fears of Gunmar's escape

programme.title: Unbecoming
programme.desc: Jim is given the chance to see what life would be like if he had never picked up the Amulet

programme.title: Mistrial And Error
programme.desc: Jim must go to trial for releasing Gunmar from the Darklands

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Ludicrous Lunacy of the Loopy Laserlightmare
programme.desc: Despite being terrible at the job, Krupp wants to be the camp director again next summer. That's something Harold and George simply cannot abide.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Shocking Showdown of the Staggering Sugamechangere
programme.desc: It's parents' weekend at Lake Summer Camp, and Krupp's eager to make amends with Harold and George ... or so he says.

programme.title: Potty Mouth
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an "internet time out"

programme.title: Imaginary Friends
programme.desc: After Boss insults Tina's imaginary friend, he's forced into "Imaginary Friend Sensitivity Training" at Baby Corp. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: Defenders Of The Universe
programme.desc: The Castle is attacked by an alien battle cruiser. The new Paladins must form Voltron for the first time in 10,000 years.

programme.title: Some Assembly Required
programme.desc: Princess Allura puts the Paladins through a rigorous training program in hopes of putting aside their differences and working together as a team.

programme.title: Lucky And The Treacherous Trail
programme.desc: When Lucky gets wind of an advanced trail ride she decides to become the best frontier girl anyone has ever seen.overnight

programme.title: Why Warthog Is Ugly
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Warthog was really rather handsome. And did he know it! He strutted around Tinga Tinga as if he owned the place. All the animals were fed up with Warthog's boasting, and then one day Lion decided to give chase. Yikes! Warthog ran headfirst into Porcupines burrow! After that, he was no longer the prettiest beast in Tinga Tinga. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Why Owls Head Turns All The Way Round
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Owl's head didn't turn all the way round. She had tiny little eyes and tiny little ears, and she found it very hard to stay awake. Then one day all the Mangoes started disappearing in Tinga Tinga. Against all the animals better judgement, Owl was ordered to watch over the Mango tree … but the mangoes kept disappearing.

programme.title: Heavy Loader
programme.desc: Roary takes Loada on a jaunt to the beach… only to discover that sand and lorries don't mix too well!

programme.title: Testing Time For Maxi
programme.desc: PC Pete and Nick are up at Silver hatch giving the cars their road tests. Is Maxi really going to be as good as he says he is or will he be unpleasantly surprised?

programme.title: Mum's The Word
programme.desc: Christine (Big Chris' mum) is visiting Silver hatch. As is Mamma Mia… serious competition ensues!

programme.title: How The Hatch Was Won
programme.desc: Tin Top is feeling homesick so Big Chris tries to cheer him up. But who could that pesky varmint causing trouble on the track be?!

programme.title: Go Gadget James And Maxi
programme.desc: Maxi is jealous of all of James' gadgets, or more precisely, the attention the other cars give him. He persuades Molecom to devise some gadgets for him… with hilarious results

programme.title: Mr Carburettor Or Bust
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor has commissioned a bust of himself for Silver Hatch. Disaster strikes when it is dropped, Big Chris tries to make amends, while Marsha distracts Mr Carburettor and the reporter

programme.title: Spinny Water / Kelp's Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. / Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders get stuck in a cave with their rival, Magnus, during a race to find a new source of an important mineral.

programme.title: The Really Really Big Lie
programme.desc: When Julien concocts an elaborate lie, blaming a giant "mega-gecko" for ruining a young lemur's birthday party.

programme.title: One More Cup
programme.desc: Julien finds a bag of coffee beans in the Cove of Wonders and gets the entire lemur community hooked on caffeine.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: Escape from L.A.
programme.desc: Tony and his crew have been working as spy racers in LA for a while now and are itching to go international. Whey they discover a mysterious man with a strange tattoo of a formula in a smuggling ring bust, Ms. Nowhere finally agrees to let them go to Rio to investigate the tattoo and the whereabouts of one of her agents who has gone dark - Layla Gray.

programme.title: That Sinking Feeling
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere drops the kids off in Brazil and leaves to go on her own important mission, but things immediately go south for Tony and his crew. When the hauler and gear gets caught in quicksand, Tony needs to learn that a good leader knows when to accept help.

programme.title: Dog the Right Thing
programme.desc: In preparation for the big race to determine the next Race Cadets, Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to build their own cars. The catch? The car parts are scattered throughout Pawston. \ The Not Yet Cadets compete in the final race to see which team will join the Race Cadets.

programme.title: All Paws on Deck / Bonestand and Deliver
programme.desc: Tag wants to do something special for her Mom and Paw’s anniversary, so she recreates the boat cruise where her parents first met. \ Tag discovers that nothing is planned for Pawston’s 100th birthday, so she decides the town needs to rebuild the old Bonestand for a big Pawston concert.

programme.title: The Yarn Fairy / Bake It ‘Til You Make It
programme.desc: When the trees start losing their leaves, Phoebe begins knitting the trees in the park sweaters, but when the neighborhood kids see the sweaters they think they're a mysterious "Yarn Fairy," and they want to see her in action, making it much harder for the Dews to put more sweaters on the latest trees that have lost their leaves.

programme.title: Things That Go Bump / Hide Like a Dew Drop
programme.desc: When "something" starts snatching things and causing havoc in Marcus' house, Phoebe and the Dew Drops investigate only to find that it's a stray kitten that they need to catch and find a home for before Marcus returns home. But in the end, Marcus decides to take the kitty in, as his own. / Lola isn't very good at "Hide & Seek" so the Dew Drops help her improve her game. But she becomes so good that no one can find her! And now she’s going to be late to her own surprise tea party!

programme.title: Lost and Found / In the Park In the Dark
programme.desc: The Community Center's Lost and Found is full and it's up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. / Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Longest Yardwork / The Girl Who Cried Goose
programme.desc: Donna plans a garden party for Rona, but the only problem is that her garden is overgrown and neglected. The team try to transform this jungle into a backyard just in time for the party. / Lula finds an angry goose on the loose, and Team Zenko need to get it out of the park before soccer camp starts.

programme.title: Kitty Pirates
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a pirate treasure map in the shape of the dollhouse (a piece of it has been torn off). This must mean it’s time for a pirate treasure hunt in the dollhouse! Pirate Gabby and Pirate Pandy head out on their journey across the many "lands" of the dollhouse to find the Gabby Cats Treasure!

programme.title: MerCat Gets Her Sparkle Back
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes beakers filled with a magical potion, they conjure up an invite for Spa Day at the dollhouse! However, while decorating for MerCat's favorite day of the year, MerCat accidentally loses her color and sparkle. Gabby and Pandy must help her get her sparkle back for the big Spa Day party!

programme.title: Zero Dunk Thunky / Pie Vs Pie
programme.desc: Thunk is captured by the Broods and develops feelings for Blurg /At the Valley's food competition, Thunk and Ugga mistakenly make a new hit food

programme.title: Super Smash Siblings / A Hole In Grug
programme.desc: Eep and Thunk compete against their classmates in "Ahhh-Smashin"/After being denied a spot on the Valley's Wall of Fame, Grug creates a new game

programme.title: Federal Slumber Party
programme.desc: Uncle Benji makes a surprise visit to the Templeton Family with a cute baby of his own: Lil Bit Guerrero! Tina gets jealous of Carol doting on Lil Bit, while Benji reveals that in order to make his daughter proud of him, he’s applied to become a Federal Agent. With Boss Baby’s cover at stake, it’s up to the Templeton Family to get Benji out of their hair as he sniffs around for a case that could garner the attention from federal law enforcement.

programme.title: Floaties
programme.desc: A bummed out Tina takes a vacation to the baby resort, Floaties! However, her mind is still back at work, and struggled to actually enjoy her vacation. And it gets worse when Crispin Biscuits switches electronic ID tags with her, causing everyone to assume Tina actually is Crispin Biscuits. With Crispin having booked her for a seemingly endless stay, Tina is trapped in a paradise nightmare, and in a tunnel of madness starts to think that she may even be Crispin.

programme.title: Quake, Rattle And Roll
programme.desc: Fishlegs and Meatlug liberate the Gronckles from a menacing dragon that has encroached on their ancestral home, Dark Deep.

programme.title: Have Dragon Will Travel Pt 1
programme.desc: The Dragon Riders are surprised to discover who is behind recent attacks on nearby ships - and to learn exactly what the ships are.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Strange Strife of the Smelly Socktopus
programme.desc: After Erica convinces them that being suspended is a great vacation, George and Harold pull off every prank they can think of in order to get suspended

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Flustering Mindless Woe of the Flushable Memory Wipes
programme.desc: After being made fun of for sitting in chocolate pudding, George and Harold go into hiding only to come back to find that everybody has forgotten who they are

programme.title: Bad Omen
programme.desc: When Omen hijacks the Mothership and Royal Cores, all seems lost for our heroes. The Royal heirs are able to defeat the killer Blank, but at a high cost.

programme.title: Moving Day
programme.desc: After last season’s victory, Aja and Krel struggle to relocate Mothership back to their Arcadia Oaks neighborhood, but their task is complicated when Toby and Eli discover the Royals’ Akiridion secret.

programme.title: Moonlight Run
programme.desc: Aja and Krel hitch a ride in Stuart’s old UFO on a mission to rescue Vex from a bounty hunter outpost on the Moon. Meanwhile, Zadra receives intel about Morando from a surprising new ally.

programme.title: Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: One Last Job
programme.desc: The team plans a heist in order to obtain the enchanted pendant that can lead them to the storm wheels. Elsewhere, Klaus and Veruca shipwreck on a mysterious island that is actually home to the mages, and also the Tianshang weapon helmet.

programme.title: Doom and Groom
programme.desc: Po and the team have one last attempt to get the pendant, but they will have to disrupt Jayesh's wedding, and contend with his guards, to do so. At the mage island, Klaus and Veruca get hold of the Tianshang helmet.

programme.title: The Pinging
programme.desc: Mr. Ping is possessed by the ghost of Master Mastodon, the ancient master sworn to protect the Tianshang storm wheels. After a ghostly sewer chase, Mastodon agrees to help our team to stop Klaus and Veruca. He reveals that their next step is to go across the sea to Central America.

programme.title: The S. S. Friend-ship
programme.desc: After the PALs encourage Maricela to make new friends, she forms the exclusive "Poshy Posse" with Priya, Sahir and Alex.

programme.title: The Gavel of Justice
programme.desc: Someone stole Bebe's gavel and used it to break a window at the academy! Everyone seems to suspect Alex ... but Pru is certain he's innocent.

programme.title: The Rival Racer
programme.desc: A swift new recruit joins the school racing team, putting Lucky's dreams of riding out front in jeopardy. Pru and Abigail clash over a class project.

programme.title: Thunk O'clock High / The Croo-Gitive
programme.desc: Thunk must face a bully that's notorious for being an animal/The Croods flee after Grug is accused of robbing caves and stealing food for the Broods

programme.title: A Few Good Grugs / Valley Shine Day
programme.desc: The Valley has the first "try-all" against the Croods to see if Grug stole food for the Broods; Thunk asks Kevin to teach him to be more irresistible

programme.title: Chalk The Line / Weighting Is The Hardest Part
programme.desc: Eep cheats her way into being considered an adult; Grug learns he's no longer the strongest caveman and turns to a radical method for building brawn

programme.title: Total Nightmare
programme.desc: When Hookfang is drawn to a female Monstrous Nightmare, Snotlout tries to break them up before he loses his friend forever.

programme.title: Team Astrid
programme.desc: After Dagur attacks Berk, Astrid trauns a crew of back-up Dragon riders to battle back, although no one anticipates how soon the strike will come.

programme.title: Night Of The Hunters Pt 1
programme.desc: When Stormfly is captured by a new enemy, Ryker Grimborn, and the Dragon Hunters, Hiccup, Toothless and the team must rescue her before it's too late

programme.title: In The Hall Of The Gumm-Gumm King
programme.desc: When Gunmar marches for Heartsone Trollmarket, the Trollhunting team must save the remaining Trolls and face Gunmar before all is lost

programme.title: Night Patroll
programme.desc: TheTrollhunters struggle to keep Trolls a secret in Arcadia.

programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! Amanda Buckner and Tara LaRosa are two of the world's best female fighters. Both are highly trained in Brazilian jiu-jitsu, Judo and Muay Thai, watch them face off in Costa Rica.

programme.title: MEGA Fights Paul Williams vs. Erislandy Lara
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features a welterweight bout between former champion Paul 'The Punisher' Williams (39-2, 27 KOs) and up and comer Erislandy Lara, aka 'The American Dream", 15-0, 10 KOs). The fight took place at Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, on July 9, 2011.

programme.title: Men's Forms Championships
programme.desc: This episode features highlights from the Men's Forms Championships as well as Girl's Weapons, Synchronized Team Forms and Boy's and Girl's Traditional Weapons.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Arturo Gatti vs. Carlos Baldomir
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a welterweight world championship contest featuring Arturo Gatti and Carlos Baldomir. Baldomir looks to continue his rise in the welterweight ranks. Also on the card, a classic welterweight title brawl between Andre Berto and Victor Ortiz.

programme.title: Nagoya, Japan: Show 4
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Show 4 featuring Shodai, Aoiyama, Takagenji and Hakuho from the Nagoya basho.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights James Kirkland vs. Alfredo Angulo
programme.desc: This episode features James Kirkland as he faces Alfredo Angulo in an explosive, hard-hitting fight, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!

programme.title: Prison Fighters
programme.desc: This series follows former Muay Thai champion Noy Khaopan and American Cody Moberly, two inmates in a Thailand prison, who after seven years are given the chance to fight for their release. By joining a controversial government modern day Prison Fight program, murderers and felons are given the chance to fight for their freedom, and possible redemption, through the ancient tradition of Muay Thai matches. Episode 1 of 4.

programme.title: 康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#16[粤]
programme.desc: 少龙得知琴清并非龙阳君之妻，精神一振。少龙出席由琴清主持的才士论政，遇见历史名人韩非及李斯，兴奋不已，又劝李斯到秦国大展鸿图；一番法治精神及大王与庶民同罪论，众人诧异。少龙借拨泻酒换衣服取回秘录，交赵雅借醉带走，惊悉赵倩被接入皇宫，赶往营救。魏太子欲对赵倩无礼，幸少龙及时赶至并胁持太子。赵倩为少龙挡了一箭。龙阳君冒险带二人返水榭。少龙替赵倩拔箭后担心她伤口发炎，此时信陵君率众搜水榭，琴清情急生计。

programme.title: 东张西望[粤]
programme.desc: 长者乘的士时发现车厢内有两只名贵手表，司机称长者可付钱取走，惟长者推托后，即被恶言威胁？某私家车与跑车在观塘绕道相撞，私家车司机被对方指控突切线生意外；卢觉强教授分析后，揭露事情始末并非如此？报料人有位自称投资专家的多年好友，广邀身边人加入其投资群组，众人共注资数百万到其私人户口，想套现时却遭不同理由拖延；事主自觉信错人致损失惨重！几位参加《中年好声音4》的艺人终脱去面罩，罗天宇称此举令他感压力？

programme.title: 流行都市[粤]
programme.desc: 对人生有焦虑属正常，重要的是学懂应付与疏理情绪。精神科医生细说焦虑症的定义、病征，如何作初步自我判断？医生亦建议采用「BREAK」放松减压，详情怎样？外地心脏团体于2025年发表最新的高血压管理指引，强调「及早发现、及早治疗」。心脏科医生概括新指引的三大重点，个中有甚么细节常被忽略？另外，学者细谈服用灵芝孢子保健的注意事项。就算不是过节，意头却不会嫌多，许美德师傅在「睇𩠌食饭」奉上「八宝福袋」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在广州[粤]
programme.desc: 广州，粤菜发源地之一，广府菜的中心，是每一位食客都无法拒绝的美食圣地。爱吃爱玩的主持人麦包，在广州彻底释放了吃货天性，走遍大街小巷，寻找地道美食：悠闲早茶、西关小吃、新潮佳馔，夜市小摊...

programme.title: 单恋双城#20[粤][PG]
programme.desc: 经理人不保证为她出唱片，以荞拒绝签约。以荞酒后向恭梓哭诉说出心底话；恭梓向云锋辞职，式适猜到他欲帮助以荞。以荞催促恭梓尽快作曲，恭梓力不从心。展博突取消约会，式适打电话又找不到他，发现展博与淇英一起。

programme.title: 高朋满座#47[粤]
programme.desc: 义与娜成为情侣，庆发动全家拉近与娜这上等人的距离，既强迫娜学习下厨，更要她陪悦及喜狂煲剧集及上山祈福拜神。娜找亨求救欲争取和义独处，正当娜满以为「奸计」得逞时，却发现高家众人的破坏力，实远超她的想像。

programme.title: 天龙八部#19[粤/普][PG]
programme.desc: 坦之以血喂蜈蚣助阿紫练毒掌，误打误撞仿效易筋经招式解了毒，以血喂冰蚕断气后被丢进河里又活过来。星宿派与丐帮打斗，春秋见坦之能抗毒便收他为徒。阿紫被萧峰责骂后出走，段誉未能破解珍珑棋局，慕容复也来一试。

programme.title: Sunday靓声王[粤]
programme.desc: 郑少秋以一首<几度夕阳红>拉开今集序幕，与陈浩德、方伊琪、钟舒漫、钟舒褀、郑世豪几代歌星放送粤语时代曲。深受星马地区欢迎的郑锦昌以<唐山大兄>、<十一哥>来会观众，并与后辈郑世豪合唱<禅院钟声>。

人大会议开幕 政府工作报告[粤]
programme.desc: 十四届全国人大四次会议，3月5日在北京揭幕，会议除了审议总理提交的《政府工作报告》，以及多部法律草案，包括《中华人民共和国国家发展规划法(草案)》、《中华人民共和国生态环境法典(草案)》等，更重要审查批准「十五五」规划纲要草案。中共二十届四中全会审议通过的「国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划」，决定中国未来五年发展方向，涵盖科技自立自强、人工智能、全融强国建设，以及推动重大工程项目等。

programme.title: 天龙八部#20[粤/普][PG]

programme.title: 阿爷厨房[粤]
programme.desc: 鼎爷、阿谭怀念港式糕饼，并随唐饼师傅学做经典马仔，儿时回忆的味道！鼎爷制作怀旧食品虾子、金华火腿味的「鸳鸯扎蹄」，虾子与甜豉油味道绝配；捆扎腐皮时必须扎实，慎防扎蹄走样！要令腐皮快速软身，有何方法？两位主持往工场窥探濑粉(攦粉)的制作过程，能保持爽滑口感的秘诀在哪？鼎爷亦会炮制「鱼腐米线」，先煲出阵阵鱼香的大眼鸡鱼汤，紧记阿爷教落的起鲮鱼肉小贴士。将剁碎的鱼蓉加入全蛋、蛋白之内，又有甚么作用？
